contribution: 本文提出了一种**感知宇宙学参数的六维相空间超分辨率生成对抗网络（GAN）模型**，能够联合生成粒子的位移和速度场。该模型以演化后的低分辨率场以及 5 个标准宇宙学参数（$\Omega_m, \Omega_b, h, n_s, \sigma_8$）为条件输入，利用 Quijote 拉丁超立方模拟集的 100 对高低分辨率样本在 $z = 0$ 处完成训练，实现了在 $1\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Gpc}$ 盒子中将粒子数从 $512^3$ 提升至 $1024^3$。在 10 个未参与训练的独立测试宇宙学模型中，该方法**准确重构了物质分布、成团性变化以及暗物质晕丰度**：在 $0.1 < k < 3\,h\,\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$ 尺度范围内，功率谱最大绝对误差均值仅为 **$3.6\%$**；在 $M < 10^{14.8}\,h^{-1} M_\odot$ 的质量区间内，FoF 暗物质晕丰度与真实高分辨率模拟的吻合度在 **$15\%$** 以内。此外，研究表明利用基准模型校准可显著压制系统误差并**有效消除宇宙学参数推断中的系统性偏差**，为跨参数空间的高保真快速模拟及场级宇宙学推断提供了实用工具。
summary: We present a cosmology-aware generative model for super-resolution (SR) of cosmological $N$-body simulations in particle phase space. The model jointly generates displacements and velocities, conditioning a generative adversarial network (GAN) based generator and discriminator on evolved low-resolution (LR) fields and five $Λ$CDM parameters $(Ω_m,Ω_b,h,n_s,σ_8)$. We train a single model on 100 matched low-high resolution pairs from the Quijote Latin-hypercube suite at $z = 0$, mapping $512^3$ to $1024^3$ particles in $1\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Gpc}$ boxes. On ten cosmologies excluded from SR training, the model reproduces the broad matter distribution and the cosmological variation of clustering and halo abundances. Over $0.1<k<3\,h\,\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$, the mean of the per-cosmology maximum absolute power-spectrum errors is $3.6\%$, while FoF halo abundances agree with HR to within $15\%$ in the analyzed mass bins below $10^{14.8}\,h^{-1}M_\odot$. Satellite abundances and occupations retain larger, mass-dependent discrepancies. Corrections measured at one near-fiducial cosmology reduce a shared component of these systematic errors when applied to the other nine test cosmologies. A power spectrum based inference test also shows that calibration reduces the mean shifts in all parameters. These results extend our SR model across cosmologies and provide 6D phase space realizations for subsequent studies of non-linear structure and field-level cosmological inference.

title: Optimizing Color Selection for Cluster-Member Identification with SuperBIT
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最大尺度的引力束缚维里化系统，其成员星系的丰富度（richness）分布是追踪星系团内部恒星质量和暗物质分布的重要探针。在缺乏大样本光谱巡天的情况下，利用多波段测光数据中的“红序列”（Red Sequence）特征——即早期型被动演化星系在色-星等图上形成的紧密线性关系——是高效证认星系团成员星系的核心研究范式。超压气球成像望远镜（SuperBIT）在平流层开展高分辨率光学与近紫外成像，能够在接近空间环境的条件下进行宽视场观测。针对其特定的波段组合优化颜色选择，对于降低星系团成员证认的污染率与提高星系样本纯度至关重要。
contribution: 本研究利用超压气球成像望远镜（SuperBIT）于 2023 年 4 月科学飞行期间获取的多波段成像数据，结合已通过光谱确认的星系团成员样本，对 SuperBIT 的三个波段所构建的 $(u-b)$、$(b-g)$ 和 $(u-g)$ 三种测光颜色在成员星系证认中的表现进行了基准测试。通过定量分析成员星系在颜色空间中的 $1\,\sigma$ 色散以及分类算法的纯度，**发现 $(b-g)$ 颜色在整个星系团样本及覆盖的红移范围内均展现出最小的色散与最高的证认纯度**。该研究**确立了 $(b-g)$ 作为基于红序列证认星系团成员的最优颜色组合**，为未来利用 SuperBIT 多波段测光数据深入分析星系团星系族群奠定了方法基础。
summary: Galaxy richness maps provide a useful tracer of the stellar mass distribution in galaxy clusters, but identifying cluster members from multiband photometric data can be challenging. In this work, we investigate multiband imaging data obtained with the Super-Pressure Balloon-borne Imaging Telescope (SuperBIT) during its science flight in April 2023. Using spectroscopically identified cluster members across the SuperBIT cluster sample, we benchmark the performance of the three colors available from the three SuperBIT bands: $(u-b)$, $(b-g)$, and $(u-g)$. We quantify the performance of each color using the $1\,σ$ scatter of the spectroscopically identified members in color and the purity of our cluster-member identification algorithm. We find that $(b-g)$ consistently exhibits the smallest color scatter and highest purity across the sample and over the redshift range probed by SuperBIT. We therefore identify $(b-g)$ as the preferred color for red-sequence-based cluster-member identification, providing a basis for future analyses of the cluster galaxy population using SuperBIT multiband photometry.

title: Design and development of the PRIMAger instrument for PRIMA
background_knowledge: 中远红外（Mid- to Far-Infrared）波段是研究冷尘埃辐射、分子气体、星际介质磁场结构以及被尘埃遮蔽的恒星形成与星系演化过程的关键窗口。由于地球大气的强吸收以及常温光学系统的热噪声干扰，高灵敏度的远红外天体物理观测极度依赖于深低温冷却的空间天文台。在超导探测技术中，动态电感探测器（Kinetic Inductance Detector, KID）凭借其极高的探测灵敏度、天然支持大阵列射频频分复用读出等优势，成为新一代空间远红外焦平面仪器的核心选择。为了实现极低暗电流和高信噪比，KID 探测器通常需配合连续绝热去磁制冷机（CADR）等低温系统降温至 $0.1\text{ K}$ 量级的亚开尔文温区，这为空间红外仪器的光机电热一体化集成与在轨性能验证带来了极大的工程与技术挑战。
contribution: 本文介绍了 NASA 探路者级远红外空间天文台 PRIMA 的核心成像仪器 **PRIMAger 的总体设计与研制方案**。该仪器包含两大科学观测模式：一是覆盖波长 $24 \sim 84\ \mu\text{m}$、光谱分辨率 $R \ge 8$ 的**高光谱成像模式**（由线性渐变滤光片实现）；二是覆盖 $92 \sim 235\ \mu\text{m}$（划分 4 个宽带）的**多波段偏振成像模式**。两套通道均基于工作在 $0.125\text{ K}$ 的超敏感 KID 探测器阵列构建。论文系统阐述了维持在 $1\text{ K}$ 的光机主体结构、亚开尔文热接口与读出电子学等关键子系统设计，评估了其**技术指标合规性与预期观测性能**，并制定了应对在轨性能验证挑战的测试与工程研制路线。
summary: PRIMA (PRobe far-Infrared Mission for Astrophysics) is an infrared space observatory designed to operate over the next decade. Equipped with a 1.8 m telescope actively cooled to 4.5 K, the project is currently in the concept study phase as part of the NASA Probe Explorers program. PRIMA will carry two instruments: FIRESS and PRIMAger. PRIMAger will offer two observation modes: hyperspectral imaging and polarimetric imaging. Both channels will use ultra-sensitive kinetic inductance detector (KID) arrays, covering wavelengths from mid-infrared to far-infrared. A European consortium will develop the cold unit of the PRIMAger instrument while the Readout Electronics and Continuous Adiabatic Demagnetization Refrigerator (CADR) will be provided by Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) and shared between the 2 instruments. The hyperspectral mode will cover the 24-84 $μ$m range with a spectral resolution of R $\ge$ 8, ensured by a linear variable filter placed in front of the detector. The polarimetric mode will provide polarimetric imaging in four broad bands from 92 to 235 $μ$m, using KIDs with three polarization orientations. The main structure of the instrument is the optomechanical assembly, cooled at 1K. It supports at first the two focal plane array assemblies incorporating 0.125K detector stages. In addition, the main structure is providing the interfaces for the 0.125K thermal link, the readout cables and the filters. This paper presents the technical requirements and expected performance of the instrument, as well as the associated design of the sub-systems ensuring compliance. A major challenge will be in-flight performance verification. We will also detail the development strategy, including the planned verification and test program.

title: Towards a GPU-Accelerated Real-Time Imaging Pipeline for SETI at the Allen Telescope Array
background_knowledge: 地外文明搜寻（SETI）与射电暂现源观测主要致力于探测宇宙中潜在的技术签名（Technosignatures）或快速射电暴等脉冲信号。传统的搜寻方式通常依赖于波束成形（Beamforming）生成的“时间-频率”谱流，其空间分辨和多目标搜寻能力较为受限。相比之下，射电干涉成像技术能够提供完整的空间上下文，允许在宽视场的多个图像像素上同时开展时域特征分析。然而，干涉阵列产生的高维可见度数据计算量极大，加之射电脉冲穿过星际介质时会产生频散效应（由色散量 $DM$ 描述），在图像域开展多频带去色散和盲搜索需要极高的计算吞吐量与低延迟，因此依赖 GPU 高性能加速计算和流式数据架构来实现近实时的处理能力。
contribution:
本研究基于艾伦望远镜阵列（ATA）的后相关 UVH5 可见度数据，开发并测试了一套基于 GPU 加速的干涉成像与图像域色散量（DM）搜索管线，并将其集成到 CyberEther 流式数据框架中。主要贡献与结果包括：
1. **构建高效图像域搜索管线**：管线支持对覆盖 $287.5\text{ MHz}$ 带宽的 48 个频率子带构建 Stokes-I 脏图，结合四分位距缓解（IQRM）算法进行射频干扰标记与子带掩膜，扣除时间均值背景，并通过图像环形缓冲区（ring buffer）执行盲试验 DM 搜索。
2. **脉冲信号恢复验证**：在一段时长 10 分钟、包含周期性频散注入脉冲（$DM \approx 150\text{ pc cm}^{-3}$）的测试观测中，管线**成功在相位中心恢复注入源，测得最佳拟合 $DM = 150\text{ pc cm}^{-3}$**，单脉冲在图像平面的信噪比中位数达到约 52。
3. **验证实时处理可行性**：集成至 CyberEther 框架后，每个积分周期的核心计算耗时仅约 $63\text{ ms}$，**显著优于约 $98\text{ ms}$ 的原生积分时间**，证实了在可用积分时间内完成核心成像与搜索处理的能力，为后续全在线实时运行奠定了关键技术基础。
summary: Traditional technosignature and transient searches commonly operate on beamformed time--frequency products. Interferometric imaging adds spatial context and allows time-domain searches to be performed across many image pixels simultaneously. We report the development and testing of a GPU-accelerated interferometric imaging and image-domain dispersion-measure (DM) search pipeline for Allen Telescope Array (ATA) post-correlation UVH5 visibility data, integrated with the CyberEther streaming framework to replay recorded visibility data and work toward real-time operation. The pipeline forms Stokes-I dirty images from correlated visibilities, incorporates Inter-Quartile Range Mitigation (IQRM) flags into the imaging weights, images 48 frequency subbands spanning 287.5\,MHz, subtracts a temporal mean over the full observation from each subband and pixel, applies IQRM-informed subband masking, and performs a blind trial-DM search using a short-history image ring buffer. On a controlled 10-minute three-spectral-window test observation containing a periodic dispersed pulsed injection (DM\,$\approx$\,150\,pc\,cm$^{-3}$), the pipeline recovers the injected source at the phase centre with a best-fit DM\,$=$\,150\,pc\,cm$^{-3}$, with individual dispersed pulses reaching a median image-plane S/N of $\approx$52. When integrated into CyberEther, the core processing requires approximately 63\,ms per integration compared with a native integration time of approximately 98\,ms, demonstrating that the core science-processing operations can be completed within the available integration time. The present implementation operates on recorded visibility data and relies on a temporal mean and MAD noise estimate precomputed over the full observation. For live operation, these quantities will instead need to be estimated from data available up to the current integration.

title: The differences in the Narrow Line Region of nearby QSOs 1 and QSOs 2: II - Signatures of kinetic feedback
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（Active Galactic Nuclei, AGN）是中心超大质量黑洞剧烈吸积物质而释放巨大能量的天体系统。根据经典的 AGN 统一模型，1 型（Type 1 / QSO 1）与 2 型（Type 2 / QSO 2）类星体的主要差异源于视线方向与环核尘埃环（Torus）的相对夹角：QSO 1 的中心吸积盘和宽线区直接暴露在视线中，而 QSO 2 则被尘埃遮挡，仅暴露出更大尺度的窄线区（Narrow-Line Region, NLR）。窄线区不仅受宿主星系引力势支配，也是探测 AGN 动能反馈（Kinetic Feedback）和大尺度气体外流的关键区域。通过对窄线区发射线（如 $[\text{O III}]\,\lambda 5007$）进行多高斯成分分解，天文学家可以区分星系引力主导的宁静态气体和 AGN 外流驱动的高速气体，进而探究 AGN 是仅受几何视向角统一模型支配，还是经历了从“富尘埃遮掩阶段”向“吹出阶段（Blowout Phase）”再到暴露 QSO 1 的星系协同演化序列。
contribution:
本研究利用 SDSS-IV 光谱巡天数据，系统对比了红移在 $0.4 < z < 0.5$ 范围内的约 1500 个 QSO 1 和约 700 个 QSO 2 的窄线区（NLR）积分运动学特性。核心发现与结论如下：
1. **低速气体受引力势主导**：对 $[\text{O III}]\,\lambda 5007$ 和 $\text{H}\beta$ 发射线进行双成分拟合表明，两类 QSO 的窄成分速度均接近零（$v_n \sim 0$）且速度色散较低（$\sigma < 200\text{ km s}^{-1}$），证实其低速气体运动主要由宿主星系自身的引力势决定。
2. **外流运动学特征存在显著差异**：追踪 AGN 气体外流的高速宽成分参数（$v_b$、$v_{05}$、$v_{10}$、$v_{\text{[NeV]}}$、$\sigma_b$、$W80$ 和 $W90$）表现出明显不同，**QSO 1 显示出更强烈的蓝移和更宽的谱线宽度**，从而对应更高的表观质量外流率（$\dot{M}_{\text{out}}$）与动能功率（$\dot{E}_{\text{out}}$）。
3. **视向角与演化双重机制**：统计结果表明，QSO 1 更强烈的动能反馈特征主要归因于**视向角效应**（视线能直视更靠近黑洞核区、本征速度更高的内层外流气体）；同时，QSO 2 表现出更高的平均 $[\text{O III}]$ 光度，表明其可能处于**早期受遮掩的演化阶段**，随后通过吹出过程清除气体并演化为无遮掩的 QSO 1。
summary: We compare the integrated kinematic properties of the Narrow-Line Region (NLR) of ~1500 type 1 and ~700 type 2 QSOs at 0.4 < z < 0.5 using emission-line profiles from SDSS-IV spectra. The NLR [OIII] 5007 and Hbeta emission lines are fitted using a two-component model comprising a narrow (v_n, sigma_n) and a broad component (v_b, sigma_b), while fainter lines are fitted with a single Gaussian component. Both QSO types exhibit similar median narrow-component velocities (v_n ~ 0) and velocity dispersions (sigma < 200 km s^-1), consistent with motion driven by the host galaxy's gravitational potential. However, parameters associated with the broad, high-velocity gas component (v_b, v_05, v_10, v_[NeV], sigma_b, W80 and W90) differ: QSOs 1 display larger blueshifts and broader emission lines than QSOs 2. This suggests that these components trace Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) outflows, that appear stronger in QSOs 1, leading to higher estimated mass-outflow rates (\dot{M}_out) and kinetic powers (\dot{{E}_out). Rather than offering absolute determinations of \dot{M}_out and \dot{E}_out -- which remain subject to physical uncertainties -- this statistical study supports the higher NLR excitation found for QSOs 1 in Paper I, as an orientation effect: in QSOs 1, we observe gas closer to the AGN core, where velocities and velocity dispersions are intrinsically higher. Nevertheless, the trend of QSOs 2 exhibiting higher average [OIII] luminosities than QSOs 1 suggests an evolutionary contribution, where QSOs 2 represent an early obscured AGN phase followed by a blowout phase that reveals the central core as a QSO 1.

title: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Wide Field Instrument: Characterization of the Brighter-Fatter Effect in a Roman H4RG-10 Detector using the Talbot Effect
background_knowledge: 在现代高精度宇宙学巡天（如弱引力透镜宇宙学测量）中，对观测系统点扩散函数（Point Spread Function, PSF）形态与尺寸的精确重构是提取微弱宇宙剪切信号的关键。然而，在广泛应用于近红外天文观测的碲镉汞（HgCdTe）焦平面阵列（如 Teledyne H4RG 系列探测器）中，存在复杂的探测器非线性物理效应。其中，“更亮-更胖效应”（Brighter-Fatter Effect, BFE）是指在曝光积分过程中，中心像素已积累的电荷产生排斥电场，导致后续产生的光生载流子发生横向偏转并漂移注入到邻近像素中。这一效应导致亮天体的实测 PSF 尺寸随通量和积分时间非线性展宽。若无法实现高精度的探测器级建模与校正，BFE 引入的系统误差将严重制约下一代宽场巡天望远镜的宇宙学探测能力。
contribution: 本研究利用 NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心探测器表征实验室的 Talbot 照明器，向罗曼空间望远镜（Roman Space Telescope）宽场相机的非飞行级 H4RG-10 探测器投影微型点源网格，**首次完成了对 Roman H4RG-10 探测器更亮-更胖效应（BFE）的高精度实验表征**。研究发现，像素有效受光面积随其与周围像素的电荷反差以 **$(-2.18 \pm 0.04) \times 10^{-6} \text{ / e}^-$** 的速率减小，定量揭示了 PSF 尺寸随曝光积分的动态展宽机制，同时证实亮源周围的总探测信号量仍**大致守恒**。此外，团队结合平场统计测量的**像素间非线性（IPNL）**参数，发展出一套适用于 H4RG 探测器的 BFE 图像校准算法。该算法成功将 **BFE 引起的有效面积变化降低了约 25 倍**，并系统探讨了校正后残余非线性的物理来源与优化方向，为 Roman 未来的高精度巡天数据处理提供了重要支撑。
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will conduct several community-driven surveys using its Wide Field Instrument (WFI), which contains 18 Teledyne H4RG-10 near-infrared detectors in the focal plane. Roman's wide area survey to measure weak gravitational lensing places particularly stringent requirements on point spread function (PSF) precision for the WFI. The brighter-fatter effect (BFE) is a nonlinear detector effect caused by the deflection of new charge away from pixels with previously accumulated charge during an exposure. As a result, the PSF measured at the detector depends on the charge contrast between pixels, and therefore the effective PSF for astronomical sources is a function of flux contrast and integration time. We present characterization of the BFE observed in a non-flight H4RG by projecting a grid of bright point sources onto the detector using the Talbot Illuminator at the NASA Goddard Space Flight Center Detector Characterization Lab. We find that the effective area of a pixel decreases by $(-2.18\pm0.04) \times 10^{-6}$ per electron of charge contrast with its neighbors, corresponding to a measurable increase in the effective PSF size over the course of an exposure. Despite charge migration, the total signal detected in the vicinity of a bright source is roughly conserved. We also analyze flat field statistics for the same detector to measure the total inter-pixel nonlinearity (IPNL), which is dominated by BFE. We present a method to correct BFE in H4RG images using the flat field IPNL results, adapted from an extant optical correction technique. The correction reduces the observed BFE by about a factor of 25 as measured by the effective pixel area change, but there is remaining nonlinearity in the corrected data. We discuss possible sources of residual nonlinearity and suggest avenues to investigate optimal BFE correction in Roman survey images.

title: Internal Radiative Feedback Triggers Global Collapse and Direct-Collapse Black Hole Formation in Metal-free Atomic-Cooling Haloes
background_knowledge: 在宇宙早期（高红移处）发现的超大质量黑洞（SMBH）对传统的黑洞吸积演化模型构成了严峻挑战。为了在宇宙年龄极小时生长到数亿甚至数十亿太阳质量，黑洞通常需要从数万至数十万太阳质量的“重种子”（Heavy Seed）黑洞开始演化。超大质量恒星（SMS）的直接坍缩（Direct Collapse Black Hole, DCBH）是形成重种子的主流机制，传统理论认为该过程必须发生在无金属、维里温度 $T_{\rm vir} \gtrsim 10^4~{\rm K}$ 的原子冷却晕中，且需要邻近星系提供极强的外部远紫外（FUV）辐射场（通常量化为 Lyman-Werner 辐射通量强度 $J_{21} \gg 1$）来光致离解氢分子（${\rm H_2}$），从而抑制气体的分子冷却和碎裂。然而，这种强外部辐射场的严苛环境在早期宇宙中极其罕见，导致理论预言的 DCBH 丰度较低。
contribution:
本文利用高精度的宇宙学辐射流体动力学模拟，系统研究了在亚临界外部远紫外辐射场（$J_{21} = 1 - 10^2$）下无金属原子冷却晕的演化，发现内部恒星辐射反馈能够有效触发超大质量恒星及 DCBH 的形成。核心工作与主要发现如下：

1. **提出两阶段演化图像**：恒星形成初期，气体通过 ${\rm H_2}$ 冷却碎裂形成第一批普通的第三星族（Pop III）恒星；随后，这些恒星释放的**内部 FUV 辐射**迅速光致离解了晕内的 ${\rm H_2}$，从而抑制了气体的后续碎裂。
2. **触发原子冷却整体坍缩**：未碎裂的暖气体在自引力作用下通过原子冷却发生**整体坍缩（Global Collapse）**，驱动了高达 $\sim 0.1 - 1~{\rm M_\odot~yr^{-1}}$ 的持续吸积流，在模拟结束时形成了质量达 $\sim 2 - 6 \times 10^4~{\rm M_\odot}$ 的快速吸积原恒星，并有望进一步生长为 $\sim 10^5~{\rm M_\odot}$ 的超大质量恒星并直接坍缩为黑洞。
3. **放宽重种子形成条件并解释观测丰度**：坍缩伴随成团恒星形成，产生了紧凑且质量函数偏向高质端的星族系统。估算得到的 DCBH 数密度达到 $n_{\rm DCBH} \sim 10^{-3} - 10^{-2}~{\rm cMpc^{-3}}$，足以作为韦布空间望远镜（JWST）观测到的“小红点”（Little Red Dots）和现今超大质量黑洞的前身天体。该研究证明**内部恒星辐射反馈能够促进而非阻碍超大质量恒星的形成**，大幅放宽了对外部极端辐射环境的依赖。
summary: The formation of heavy seed black holes from the collapse of supermassive stars (SMSs) is a promising pathway to the supermassive black holes (SMBHs). In the conventional direct-collapse scenario, however, SMS formation requires an extremely strong external far-ultraviolet (FUV) field to suppress H$_2$ cooling and fragmentation. Here, we use cosmological radiation-hydrodynamic simulations to show that SMSs can form in metal-free atomic-cooling haloes even under subcritical FUV backgrounds with $J_{21}=1$-$10^2$. We follow the evolution for $\sim1$-$2~{\rm Myr}$ after the onset of star formation, including FUV and ionizing radiation from stars formed within the halo. Star formation proceeds through a characteristic two-stage evolution. H$_2$ cooling initially induces fragmentation and the formation of ordinary Pop III stars. Internal FUV radiation from these stars then photodissociates H$_2$ and suppresses further fragmentation, while the surrounding warm gas reservoir contracts under self-gravity and undergoes global collapse through atomic cooling. This collapse drives inflow rates of $\sim0.1$-$1~{\rm M_\odot~yr^{-1}}$ and produces rapidly accreting protostars that reach $\sim2$-$6\times10^4~{\rm M_\odot}$ by the simulations end. Since rapid accretion is still ongoing, these objects are expected to grow to $\sim10^5~{\rm M_\odot}$ SMSs and then form direct-collapse black holes (DCBHs). The global collapse is accompanied by clustered star formation, producing a compact, top-heavy stellar system around the SMSs. The estimated DCBH abundance, $n_{\rm DCBH}\sim10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}~{\rm cMpc^{-3}}$, is high enough to provide a plausible progenitor population for Little Red Dots and present-day SMBHs. Our results demonstrate that internal stellar feedback can trigger, rather than prevent, SMS formation, substantially relaxing the external FUV requirement for heavy-seed formation.

title: Anisotropic cosmic birefringence estimates for forthcoming CMB experiments
background_knowledge: 宇宙双折射（Cosmic Birefringence, CB）是指线偏振光在时空中传播时，由于宇称不守恒相互作用导致其偏振方向发生旋转的物理效应。在标准宇宙学模型中，宇宙微波背景（CMB）的奇宇称偏振相关（如 $EB$ 和 $TB$ 交叉功率谱）在统计上期望为零。然而，如果存在通过陈-西蒙斯（Chern-Simons）项与光子发生耦合的类轴子场（Axion-like fields）或动态暗能量标量场，偏振光子的左右旋模式将产生相位差，从而在 CMB 中诱发非零的 $EB$ 信号。宇宙双折射包含各向同性（空间均匀）与各向异性（空间涨落）两个分量，其中各向异性宇宙双折射是区分均匀暗能量与非均匀轴子暗物质空间分布的核心观测探针。
contribution: 本工作预测了未来地面及空间 CMB 实验对各向异性宇宙双折射的探测敏感度。作者针对具有 Simons Observatory SAT 与 LiteBIRD 级白噪声水平的模拟天图，采用基于天区小块的局域化重建方法，通过最小化基于 $EB$ D-估计器的 $\chi^2_{EB}$ 统计量重建了局域偏振旋转角。研究发现，相比于当前的 Planck 约束，**空间卫星任务和地面巡天对各向异性宇宙双折射统计不确定度的约束能力将分别提升 26–40 倍与 11–15 倍**；在 95 % 置信度下，对标度不变振幅的预测约束上限分别达到 **$A_{\rm CB} < 3.5\times10^{-4}\,{\rm deg}^2$** 和 **$A_{\rm CB} < 7.1\times10^{-4}\,{\rm deg}^2$**（较 Planck 全天约束分别改善约 20 倍和 10 倍），为下一代 CMB 实验检验超越标准模型物理提供了量化的性能增益基准。
summary: Cosmic Birefringence (CB) is a unique probe of physics beyond the Standard Model, potentially sourced by an axion-like field coupled to photons via a Chern-Simons interaction. Recent Planck analyses have strengthened evidence for a non-zero isotropic rotation angle, yet its anisotropic component remains undetected, despite being the key to distinguishing a homogeneous quintessence-like field from spatially varying axion-like dark matter. We forecast the sensitivity of forthcoming ground- and space-based CMB experiments to anisotropic CB, applying a patch-based localization technique to simulated CMB-plus-noise maps with white noise levels representative of Simons Observatory SAT- and LiteBIRD-like sensitivities. Local rotation angles are reconstructed on independent sky patches by minimizing the $χ^2_{EB}$ statistic built from the $EB$ D-estimator. Under our idealized simulations, the forecast angular power spectrum improves current Planck-based constraints on the CB anisotropy statistical uncertainty by a factor of 26-40 for a satellite-like mission and 11-15 for a realistic ground-based footprint. Translating these into constraints on the scale-invariant amplitude, fitting the reconstructed bandpowers with a scale-invariant amplitude model, we forecast with a 95 \% C.L. $A_{\rm CB} < 3.5\times10^{-4}\,{\rm deg}^2$ for the space-like mission and $A_{\rm CB} < 7.1\times10^{-4}\,{\rm deg}^2$ for the ground-based footprint, improving on the current full-sky Planck constraint by a factor of about 20 and 10, respectively. These values represent upper bounds on the achievable gain, and indicate that forthcoming CMB experiments will be able to further shed light on anisotropic CB.

title: SCALES. II. The Internal Composition of Giant Star-Forming Clumps at $z = 1 - 4$
background_knowledge: 在宇宙正午期（$z \sim 1 - 3$），高红移星系通常富含冷气体并具有强烈的盘湍流，在其恒星形成盘中普遍观测到尺度约为 $\sim 0.5 - 1\text{ kpc}$、质量可达 $10^7 - 10^9\ \mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ 的“巨型恒星形成团块”（Giant Star-Forming Clumps）。关于这类巨型结构的物理本质，天文学界长期存在两种主流理论假说：其一认为它们是由星系盘引力不稳定性（Toomre 不稳定性）直接坍缩形成的真实长寿命物理结构，在星系演化中可能向中心迁移并促进核球的构建；其二则认为它们是观测分辨率不足导致的投影混叠假象，本质上是由若干更小尺度（百秒差距量级）的恒星团块聚集混合而成。借助强引力透镜效应的空间放大能力与詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的高敏锐度近红外成像，对巨型团块的内部结构进行亚千秒差距级乃至百秒差距级的细致剖析，是检验上述演化模型的关键研究范式。
contribution:
本研究基于 SCALES 项目，利用 JWST/NIRCam 对 $z = 1 - 4$ 处的 23 个强引力透镜星系展开高分辨率分析。作者采用高斯差分（Difference-of-Gaussian）分解方法，在 $\sim 100 - 300\text{ pc}$ 尺度上建模了解析出的子团块，并在巨型团块尺度上建模了包裹它们的延展成分（EC），最终有效证认出 44 个巨型团块。研究主要发现：
1. **巨型团块的恒星质量内部构成与从宿主星系团块恒星质量函数中随机抽样的分布一致**；该结论在定性上能够同时包容长寿命巨型团块（需内部成分持续更新）以及小团块视线混合这两种理论场景，为现有星系形成数值模拟提供了精细的经验质量分布约束。
2. **团块恒星质量函数无法由斜率 $\approx 2$ 的单幂律完整表征，而是在 $\sim 10^{7.4}\ \mathrm{M}_{\odot}$ 处存在拐折（Break）并转变为更平缓的浅斜率**，揭示了高红移星系内部湍流碎裂与恒星形成反馈的关键尺度限制。
summary: Star-forming structures of scale $\sim0.5-1\,\mathrm{kpc}$, dubbed 'giant' star-forming clumps, are routinely detected in unlensed surveys of $z > 1$ galaxies. Two scenarios are usually invoked to explain their existence -- genuine physical structures or resolution-driven artifacts -- yet distinguishing between them requires characterizing their internal structure. In this work, part of the Star-Forming Clumps As Layered Emergent Structures (SCALES) series, we hence ask: What is inside a giant clump? We analyze 23 lensed galaxies at $z=1-4$ with JWST/NIRCam using difference-of-Gaussian decomposition to model (lensed) clumps at $\sim 100-300\,\mathrm{pc}$ scales, and the surrounding extended component (EC) at giant clump scales. Associating clumps to ECs, we effectively identify 44 giant clumps. Characterizing giant clump stellar mass composition using the most massive member clump and the remaining constituent clumps, we find it consistent with random sampling of the host galaxy's clump population, and hence the clump stellar mass function. This conclusion agrees qualitatively with both prevailing scenarios -- (I) dominant long-lived giant clumps, although requiring constant renewal of their constituents, and (II) giant clumps as mere blended clump associations. However, most models make no strong claims about their internal mass distribution beyond order-of-magnitude statements, and our observations thus provide an empirical constraint against which such models can be re-evaluated. Finally, using the total mass budget of clumps and ECs, we find that the clump stellar mass function cannot be described by a single power law of slope $\approx 2$, but requires a break to a shallower slope at $\sim 10^{7.4}\,\mathrm{M_{\odot}}$.

title: Comment on ''Chiral electromagnetic surface waves on Chern-Simons interfaces'' Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903 and on arXiv:2606.12513 by N. Kaloper
background_knowledge: Chern-Simons 电动力学是经典麦克斯韦电磁理论的一种重要拓扑拓展，通常通过引入拓扑项（例如轴子场与光子的 $\theta \mathbf{E} \cdot \mathbf{B}$ 耦合）来描述宇称和时间反演对称性破缺。该理论在基础物理与早期宇宙学（如原初磁场生成、宇宙双折射、轴子暗物质探测）以及凝聚态物理中的拓扑绝缘体界面处具有广泛应用。在存在 Chern-Simons 界面的系统中，界面两侧由于拓扑参数的不连续性会产生非平庸的电磁边界条件，探讨这些界面上是否存在局域传播的手征电磁表面波，是检验拓展电动力学理论自洽性与边界效应的核心物理问题。
contribution: 本文对 N. Kaloper 先前关于 Chern-Simons 界面手征电磁表面波的研究推导进行了严格检验。作者证明，Kaloper 的推导在中间步骤中**遗漏了关键数学项**；在正确计入这些修正项后，证实与平面 Chern-Simons 界面相互作用的麦克斯韦电动力学中**根本不存在局域于界面上的平面波解**。此外，文章还指出相关后续文献中试图重现该表面波解的方法**在理论推导上并不自洽**，从而澄清并修正了关于 Chern-Simons 界面电磁局域态的理论结论。
summary: We demonstrate that Maxwell electrodynamics interacting with a planar Chern-Simons interface does not have plane wave solutions localized on the interface. We re-examine the derivation of such waves presented by N. Kaloper in [Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903] and show that at an intermediate step certain terms were missed in an equation therein. Taking these terms into account changes the final conclusion of [Phys.Rev.D114(2026)L051903]. We also show that the method used in [arXiv:2606.12513 [hep-th]] to reproduce the same result is not consistent.

title: Stellar parameters and abundances for 3.2 million DESI DR1 spectra using machine learning
background_knowledge: 银河系考古（Galactic Archaeology）旨在通过精确测定数以百万计恒星的大气物理参数（如有效温度 $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$、表面重力 $\log g$、金属丰度 $[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]$ 等）以及详细的化学元素丰度模式，来追踪银河系的组装历史、恒星形成历程与化学动力学演化。随着大型光谱巡天项目（如 DESI、APOGEE、GALAH 等）的推进，海量光谱数据的产出对参数分析流水线的精度和效率提出了极高要求。传统光谱拟合通常依赖连续谱归一化过程，容易引入系统误差，尤其是在宽波段和低信噪比情况下。近年来，以 The Payne 为代表的基于人工神经网络的物理模型驱动插值方法，通过在合成光谱网格上进行高效训练，实现了对复杂多维恒星参数及多种微量元素丰度的快速、高精度自动化反演。
contribution: 本研究基于 The Payne 框架构建了一套机器学习流水线，利用约 37 万条 FGK 型恒星的合成光谱训练人工神经网络，**直接拟合经过流量定标但未进行连续谱归一化的光谱能量分布（SED）**。内部测试表明，90% 验证样本的光谱插值误差中位数低于 0.3%，且在低信噪比下仍可高精度反演参数。通过与 DESI 观测到的 6719 颗 APOGEE 和 3455 颗 GALAH 恒星样本交叉验证，该方法测定的 $T_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 与 $\log g$ **具有比 DESI 官方 SP 流水线更小的系统偏差**，这主要得益于对完整 SED 形状的直接拟合。此外，该流水线成功测定了 **12 种化学元素丰度**（Na、Mg、Al、Si、Ca、Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Ni、Ba、Y），其精度达到或优于官方流水线，并额外提供了官方未发布的 Mn、V、Ba 和 Y 丰度。最终，团队将该方法应用于 DESI DR1，发布了包含 **320 万颗恒星**的高精度恒星参数与化学丰度星表。
summary: We present a machine-learning pipeline for determining stellar parameters and chemical abundances from spectra observed by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI). Building on the model-driven Payne framework, we train an artificial neural network on ~370,000 synthetic spectra spanning FGK stars, and fit the network directly to the flux-calibrated, un-normalised spectral energy distribution (SED) of each star, rather than to a continuum-normalised spectrum as done by DESI's official Stellar Parameter (SP) pipeline. Internal accuracy tests show a median interpolation error of less than 0.3% for 90% of a synthetic verification sample, and the full fitting workflow recovers input labels to high accuracy even at low signal-to-noise ratio (S/N). Validating our method on cross-matched samples of 6719 APOGEE and 3455 GALAH stars observed by DESI with S/N > 20, we recover Teff and logg with smaller systematic offsets than the DESI SP pipeline, an improvement we attribute to fitting the full SED shape rather than a normalised spectrum. We further recover 12 elemental abundances (Na, Mg, Al, Si, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Ni, Ba, and Y) to an accuracy that matches or exceeds SP where a comparison is possible, and provide four abundances, Mn, V, Ba, and Y, that SP does not report at all. Applying this pipeline to the DESI Data Release 1 stellar sample, we deliver a catalogue of stellar parameters and abundances for 3.2 million stars.

title: An RFSoC-Based 100 GbE Spectrometer/Correlator for the Baryon Mapping Experiment: Digital Backend Design and On-Sky Validation
background_knowledge: 在射电天文干涉阵列与中性氢（HI）强度映射实验中，数字后端（Digital Backend）扮演着核心角色，负责将各天线接收到的高频微弱模拟射电信号数字化并进行频谱关联（Correlator）处理。传统的接收机系统通常需要复杂的模拟下变频链路将射频（RF）信号降至中频，再由分立的模数转换器（ADC）采样并传输给 FPGA 或 GPU 集群进行处理，这增加了系统的功耗、体积及相位不稳定性。近年来，射频片上系统（RFSoC）的兴起使得直接射频采样（Direct RF Sampling）成为可能，该技术将高速 ADC/DAC 与可编程逻辑单元集成在单颗芯片上，极大简化了射频前端设计，并结合高速网络接口（如 100 GbE）实现了高吞吐量、低延迟的干涉能见度数据传输与实时相关计算。
contribution: 本文介绍了基于 Xilinx ZCU208 射频片上系统（RFSoC）为重子映射实验（BMX）干涉阵列研制的双输入光谱仪/相关器数字后端设计及其实测验证。系统实现了在无需模拟下变频的情况下以 $1050\text{ MHz}$ 进行**直接射频采样**并信道化为 2048 个频段，板载完成自相关与互相关运算后通过 **100 GbE UDP** 协议稳定传输数据。在两次独立观测中，系统连续记录了 958,918 次累加，实现**零丢包与数据零损坏**，且在全部 $1.96 \times 10^9$ 个通道采样中严格满足柯西-施瓦茨不等式。望远镜实测成功完成了对 6 个 GNSS 频段人造卫星过境的干涉条纹探测、**天鹅座 A（Cygnus A）天顶过境的相干探测**，以及**银河系 HI 平面的独立自相关探测**；同时通过硬件资源占用模型验证了该架构向 8 输入双极化系统拓展的可行性。
summary: We describe the implementation and on-sky commissioning of a two-input spectrometer/correlator built on a Xilinx ZCU208 Radio Frequency System-on-Chip (RFSoC) and deployed on the Baryon Mapping eXperiment (BMX) interferometric array at Brookhaven National Laboratory. The system combines direct RF sampling, FPGA-based correlation, and 100 Gigabit Ethernet (GbE) visibility transport. Two inputs are digitized directly at 1050 MHz without analog downconversion and channelized into 2048 frequency channels. The correlator forms two autocorrelations and the real and imaginary parts of the cross-correlation, accumulates them in on-chip memory, and transmits the spectra as UDP packets at a fixed firmware-controlled rate. Two independent campaigns using 500 ms and 100 ms accumulation times produced 958,918 consecutive accumulations with no lost, duplicated, or malformed packets. A Cauchy-Schwarz bound is satisfied across all 1.96e9 channel-samples, confirming correct field identification and scaling. On-sky validation includes compact-source transits in six GNSS bands with the expected fringes, coherent detection of the Cygnus A zenith transit at the predicted time, and a Galactic HI plane crossing detected independently in autocorrelation on both dishes. The correlator is parameterizable in input count, with arithmetic scaling quadratically. For extension to BMX's full eight-input dual-polarization system, an occupancy model validated against the deployed firmware indicates that visibility buffering fits when moved to UltraRAM, while multi-tile synchronization, logic utilization, and timing closure remain to be demonstrated in an eight-input implementation.

title: Shared Geometry Is Not Shared Physics: A Layerwise Test of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Astronomy
background_knowledge: 随着多波段天文巡天（如光学、红外成像及光谱巡天）数据的爆发式增长，利用深度学习和基础模型（Foundation Models）融合多模态天文数据成为前沿研究范式。在机器学习领域，“柏拉图表征假说”（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）认为，不同数据模态或不同神经网络在对同一物理世界建模时，其内部表征空间会逐渐收敛并共享相似的几何结构。在天文学中，研究者普遍期望跨巡天的深度表征若能在几何流形上实现对齐，便能提取出独立于观测仪器和波段的内禀物理属性（如红移、恒星质量等）。然而，几何层面的特征空间相似性是否真正等同于模型捕获了跨模态不变的物理规律，此前仍缺乏系统性的定量检验。
contribution:
本文针对天文深度学习表征中的“柏拉图表征假说”进行了系统检验，探究**几何对齐的天文表征在科学上是否具备可替代性**。研究团队基于交叉匹配的光学图像、红外图像及光谱数据，对 36 个预训练模型的所有网络层表征进行了 139 组模型与巡天的逐层对比分析。核心发现包括：

1. **几何对齐广泛存在但非单调递增**：在对网络深度进行搜索后，所有 139 组对比均在网络的某些层展现出显著的局部邻域几何对齐；但对齐程度通常**不随网络深度单调上升**，且在连续计算块之间的差分更新中往往比计算块本身的输出表现出更强的对齐性。
2. **共享几何未能转化为共享物理**：在所有图像迁移实验中，依据几何对齐标准选取的网络层表现均显著逊于依据标签监督选取的网络层；尤为关键的是，尽管所有 HSC 与 COSMOS-Web 的最终模型对均实现了几何对齐，但在红移迁移预测任务中的决定系数 $R^2$ **全部为负**。
\n该工作表明，**神经网络在不同天文巡天之间复现相似表征几何的能力，并不等同于其学到了跨巡天不变且可线性解码的物理性质**，为未来天文学基础模型的物理可解释性与跨模态设计提供了关键警示。
summary: In this paper we investigate whether geometrically aligned astronomical representations are also scientifically interchangeable. We analyze every layer's representation from 36 pretrained models using cross-matched optical images, infrared images, and spectra. All 139 analyzed model-survey comparisons show significant local-neighborhood alignment somewhere in the network after accounting for the search over depth. However, alignment does not generally increase with network depth and can be stronger for the changes between consecutive computational blocks than for the block outputs themselves. We find that geometry-selected stages under-perform label-selected stages in every image-transfer comparison; moreover, every final HSC-COSMOS-Web model pair is aligned while every redshift transfer has negative R^2. Models can therefore recover a similar cross-survey geometry among astronomical objects without recovering a survey-invariant linear encoding of the physical properties tested here.

title: Forecasting cosmological constraints from the nonlinear halo density field with Zel'dovich-inspired transform
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学模型中，早期宇宙的原初密度扰动高度接近高斯场，其统计信息几乎完全包含在两点相关函数或功率谱中。然而，在晚期宇宙的结构形成过程中，非线性引力塌缩使物质和暗晕密度场产生了显著的非高斯性，导致大量宇宙学信息从两点统计量流失并转移到更高阶的 $N$ 点相关函数（如双谱、三谱等）中。为了避免直接计算高阶统计量所带来的高昂计算成本与复杂协方差建模，现代大尺度结构研究提出了密度场变换方法（如局部非线性高斯化变换或标记功率谱），通过在测量两点功率谱前对密度场进行数学重塑，从而以两点统计量的形式有效提取高阶关联中蕴含的非线性信息，以进一步严格限制宇宙学参数、中微子质量以及原初非高斯性。
contribution: 本文利用 Quijote 和 Quijote-PNG 宇宙学数值模拟的暗晕样本进行了 Fisher 矩阵预测分析，系统评估了基于**泽尔多维奇启发（Zel'dovich-inspired, ZI）变换**的暗晕密度场红移空间单极功率谱对宇宙学参数的约束能力。研究通过组合三个特征参数（$\eta = 1, 10, +\infty$）构建了联合统计量 $P_{\rm ZI,0}$，并首次校准了依赖于波数的尺度依赖有效噪声修正。核心发现表明：**经噪声修正的 $P_{\rm ZI,0}$ 对标准宇宙学参数、中微子质量总和及原初非高斯性振幅的约束显著强于传统暗晕功率谱 $P_{\rm h,0}$，且在多数参数上超越了标记功率谱；相比传统功率谱，其对 $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm equil}$、$f_{\rm NL}^{\rm ortho}$、$M_\nu$ 和 $n_{\rm s}$ 的约束精度分别大幅提升了 5.6 倍、5.5 倍、5.2 倍和 5.8 倍**。这证实了 ZI 变换功率谱是未来星系巡天中挖掘非线性尺度宇宙学信息的强有力互补工具。
summary: The Zel'dovich-inspired (ZI) transform is a local nonlinear transform of the density field that can Gaussianize the late-time matter field and recover information from higher-order $N$-point correlation functions through its power spectrum, with the parameter $η$ controlling the weighting of higher-order information. Using Fisher-matrix analyses of halo catalogs from the Quijote and Quijote-PNG simulations, we study the redshift-space monopole power spectrum of the ZI-transformed halo density field. The joint statistic $P_{\rm ZI,0}$, constructed from three representative transforms with $η=1$, $10$, and $+\infty$, yields substantially tighter constraints than the conventional halo power spectrum $P_{\rm h,0}$ on standard cosmological parameters, the summed neutrino mass, and primordial non-Gaussianity amplitudes, while outperforming the marked power spectrum for many parameters. We further calibrate a scale-dependent noise correction for the ZI power spectrum, with an effective noise amplitude that depends on wavenumber, and find that the correction further tightens the constraints. In particular, the noise-corrected $P_{\rm ZI,0}$ improves the constraints on $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm equil}$, $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm ortho}$, $M_ν$, and $n_{\rm s}$ by factors of $5.6$, $5.5$, $5.2$, and $5.8$, respectively, relative to $P_{\rm h,0}$. These results demonstrate the potential of ZI power spectra as a complement to standard two-point statistics for extracting nonlinear cosmological information. Our forecasts may be conservative because the halo catalogs have substantially lower number densities than those expected from forthcoming galaxy surveys.

title: Feedback-Driven Interaction of Expanding Molecular Clouds in the LDN 1204-Sh2 145-Sh2 140 Complex
background_knowledge: 大质量恒星通过强烈的紫外辐射电离、恒星风和超新星爆发向周围星际介质（ISM）注入巨大的能量与动量，这一过程统称为恒星反馈（Stellar Feedback）。恒星反馈会电离并加热气体，驱动电离氢区（H II 区）向外膨胀，在分子云中扫出扩张的空洞与致密壳层（Shells）。当不同反馈源驱动的膨胀壳层发生碰撞或相互挤压时，界面处气体的压缩会显著增强局部湍流并诱发密度聚集，从而形成中心-纤维状系统（Hub-Filament System, HFS）等致密结构。这种由外力挤压触发气体塌缩形成下一代恒星的机制（如“收集与塌缩”模型），是理解大质量恒星形成、团簇演化以及星系尺度恒星形成调控的关键环节。
contribution:
本研究利用多波段观测数据对包含 LDN 1204、Sh2 145 与 Sh2 140 的延伸分子云复合体进行了深入分析，揭示了**恒星反馈驱动的分子云相互作用及其触发恒星形成过程**。主要科学发现包括：

1. **识别出双膨胀壳层结构**：分子谱线与红外图像揭示了两个尺度约为 $14 \sim 18\text{ pc}$ 的半弧状/壳层结构，分别与已知的大质量 O 型星相关。分子谱线运动学将其分解为速度分别为 $-15 \sim -9.5\text{ km s}^{-1}$ 与 $-9 \sim -3\text{ km s}^{-1}$ 的两个独立成分，且二者在位置-速度（P-V）图上均呈现**典型的反 C 形膨胀特征**。
2. **交界面致密结构的形成**：在两个膨胀云块投影交界处的 LDN 1204A 和 LDN 1204B 子区域，Herschel 观测识别出**候选中心-纤维状系统（HFS）**，其峰值柱密度分别达到 $3.1 \times 10^{23}\text{ cm}^{-2}$ 和 $1.3 \times 10^{23}\text{ cm}^{-2}$。
3. **触发活跃恒星形成**：二阶矩（速度弥散）图显示两壳层交界区域的湍流运动显著增强，同时年轻恒星天体（YSOs，尤其是 Class I YSOs）高度聚集在 LDN 1204 子区域，有力证明了**反馈驱动的壳层膨胀与碰撞有效挤压了交界气体**，为纤维状致密结构的孕育及正在进行的恒星形成创造了必要条件。
summary: We present a multi-wavelength study of an extended molecular cloud hosting the LDN 1204, Sh2 145, and Sh2 140 regions to investigate the interplay between stellar feedback, cloud dynamics, and star formation. Infrared images reveal two semi-arc/shell-like structures (extent 14-18 pc) associated with known massive O-type stars. Herschel temperature and column density maps identify one hub-filament system (HFS) candidate toward both LDN 1204A and LDN 1204B sub-regions, with peak column densities of 3.1 x 10^23 and 1.3 x 10^23 cm^-2, respectively. These sub-regions are located at the periphery of the Sh2-145 H ii region. Molecular line data reveal a large arc-/shell-like cloud resolved into two kinematically distinct components spanning -15 to -9.5 km s^-1 and -9 to -3 km s^-1. Each component exhibits an arc-/shell-like morphology, is centered on one of the massive stars, and displays an inverted C-shaped position-velocity structure, indicating expansion driven by its associated H ii region. Both LDN sub-regions are located at the projected interface of the two expanding cloud components. Young stellar objects (YSOs), particularly Class I YSOs, are concentrated toward these sub-regions, while moment 2 maps reveal enhanced velocity dispersion, suggesting increased turbulent motions at the interface. Altogether, the presence of dense filaments, candidate hub-filament systems, and active star formation in LDN 1204 sub-regions demonstrates that feedback driven shell expansion and interaction compressed the gas at the interface, establishing the necessary conditions for filaments and ongoing star formation. These results highlight the important role of feedback-driven cloud interactions in regulating dense structure formation and star formation in molecular clouds.

title: Finding the evolutionary link between ULIRGs and radio galaxies
background_knowledge: 超亮红外星系（Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxies, ULIRGs）是红外光度超过 $10^{12} L_{\odot}$ 的极端尘埃系统，通常起源于富气体星系的剧烈大并合（major merger）。在经典的星系演化图像中，气体受引力扰动向中心快速吸积，触发强烈的星暴（starburst）并唤醒中心超大质量黑洞吸积形成活动星系核（AGN）。随着演化推进与辐射/外流反馈，星系中的尘埃气体被逐渐清除或耗尽，系统预期会向类星体或射电星系演化。其中，吉赫兹峰谱源（GPS）和致密陡谱源（CSS）通常被视为处于演化最早期（年龄极年轻）的新生射电星系。通过低频射电连续谱观测测定射电转折频率、谱年龄以及延展结构，是量化星暴与 AGN 相对能量贡献、捕捉星系从富尘埃并合体向射电星系演化过渡相的核心观测手段。
contribution: 本研究利用升级版巨米波射电望远镜（uGMRT）观测及多波段射电存档数据，对 $38$ 个 ULIRGs 样本开展了系统的射电特征与演化状态普查。核心发现如下：1. 在获得完整射电能谱的 $30$ 个源中，有 $17$ 个源呈现出位于 $63$ 至 $509\text{ MHz}$ 之间的低频转折，推断其射电谱年龄在 $0.009$ 至 $44\text{ Myr}$ 之间；有 $8$ 个源探测到了投影线尺度为 $0.7$ 至 $11\text{ kpc}$ 的延展射电结构。2. 能量学分析表明，**活动星系核（AGN）而非恒星形成活动是这些系统中主导的核心能量来源**。3. 样本中多数 ULIRGs（尤其是处于后并合阶段的源）均展现出类似 GPS 或 CSS 的年轻射电谱特征，**有力支持了 ULIRGs 正在演化为年轻射电星系的演化图景**。4. 在强星暴特征的 $6$ 个源中发现了低频转折和极年轻谱年龄，**证实其中心宿主着被尘埃深度遮蔽的埋藏 AGN**。
summary: Ultraluminous infrared galaxies (ULIRGs) are the remnants of the major mergers of gas-rich galaxies. They are dusty systems and are extremely luminous in the infrared. Both starbursts and active galactic nucleus (AGN) activity supply power in these systems, but it is not clear how these two activities are related to the overall evolution of the merger remnant. Studies suggest that there may be an evolutionary link between ULIRGs and radio galaxies. Radio observations of ULIRGs are a useful tool for understanding this evolutionary path as well as studying the energy contributions from starbursts and AGN. We perform a systematic census of these signatures in 38 ULIRGs using upgraded Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope observations and archival radio data. In the sample, 30 sources have enough frequency coverage to obtain their radio spectrum. Of these, 17 sources show a turnover frequency between 63 and 509 MHz and a spectral age variation from 0.009 to 44 Myr. Also, eight sources have extended structures with projected linear sizes varying from 0.7 to 11 kpc. Our results indicate that the primary energy source in these systems is the AGN rather than star formation. The majority of the ULIRGs in our sample, particularly those in the post-merger stage, exhibit gigahertz-peaked spectrum or compact steep spectrum-like characteristics, suggesting that they are evolving into young radio galaxies. We note that six sources with high star formation activity show a low-frequency turnover and a smaller spectral age; we confirm these six sources host buried AGN. This study enables us to trace the evolutionary link between ULIRGs and radio galaxies.

title: Beyond dust in local cosmography: covariant kinetic theory
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学模型中，冷暗物质通常被简化为无压的“尘埃”（dust），其物质流线遵循测地线运动，使得局域哈勃流中不存在内禀的偶极信号。然而，随着非线性结构形成的演化，多流交叉（stream crossing）不可避免地发生，导致尘埃模型失效；真实的冷暗物质实质上是在相空间中具有速度弥散的无碰撞气体，需通过玻尔兹曼-弗拉索夫（Vlasov）动理学方程来描述。在广义相对论框架下，相空间的速度弥散会诱导有效压强与各向异性应力，其梯度将产生非测地线的 4-加速度并激发涡度。建立超越尘埃近似的完全协变动理学理论，对于通过局域距离-红移关系（即局域宇宙测绘学）精确探测暗物质的动力学行为及其对观测多极矩的影响具有重要的理论基础意义。
contribution: 本文针对无碰撞暗物质流发展了一套**无需预设背景时空与几何对称性的完全协变动理学理论框架**。作者从精确的重质量 Vlasov 矩层级出发，构造了按速度权重组织的能量积分矩系统，并在四极矩处实现了自洽截断，封闭了包含物质能量密度、各向同性压强及各向异性压强的动力学演化。研究发现这些物理量的空间梯度会诱发物质参考系下的 4-加速度，并求得了**动量约束方程在一般情况下的非线性精确解**，同时推导了速度弥散通过 4-加速度旋度激发涡度演化的非线性表达式。进一步地，该工作将非测地线物质流应用到协变局域宇宙学中，证明了 **4-加速度对应于内禀哈勃偶极（intrinsic Hubble dipole）** 并直接进入减速多极矩，为尘埃宇宙学提供了协变动理学完备化方案，并指明了利用局域距离-红移观测直接检验无碰撞物质特性的关键物理量。
summary: Modelling cold dark matter as dust makes the matter congruence geodesic and therefore removes any intrinsic dipole from the local Hubble flow. The dust model breaks down as stream crossing develops, whereas a collisionless gas accommodates stream crossing via velocity dispersion in phase space. We develop a covariant kinetic framework for this regime without assuming a background spacetime or any geometrical symmetry. Starting from the exact massive Vlasov hierarchy, we construct its energy-integrated moments and organise these by velocity weight. A self-consistent truncation at the quadrupole closes the dynamics on the matter energy density, isotropic pressure and anisotropic pressure. Their gradients generate a matter-frame 4-acceleration, for which we find an exact nonlinear solution of the momentum constraint, valid in the general case without truncation. This goes beyond previous work in which an arbitrary 4-acceleration is introduced. Velocity dispersion also sources vorticity through the curl of 4-acceleration, and we derive the nonlinear expression for vorticity evolution. We then propagate the non-geodesic matter flow into covariant local cosmography, where the 4-acceleration is the intrinsic Hubble dipole and also enters the deceleration multipoles. Our construction provides a covariant kinetic completion of dust cosmography and identifies the quantities required to test collisionless matter directly with local distance--redshift data. A companion paper specialises the hierarchy to perturbed FLRW spacetime and predicts the size of the resulting cosmographic signals.

title: Weak lensing, Big Magnification: Recovering hidden lensing information from galaxy positions
background_knowledge: 弱引力透镜（Weak Gravitational Lensing）是探测宇宙大尺度结构、暗物质分布及暗能量状态方程的核心工具。传统的宇宙学多点统计分析通常结合星系空间成团性（Galaxy Clustering）与基于星系形状剪切（Shear）的星系-星系透镜效应，构建 $2\times2\text{pt}$ 或 $3\times2\text{pt}$ 关联函数。除了改变星系图像形状，引力透镜还会引起放大效应（Lensing Magnification）：它不仅会放大背景天体的通量，使原本低于巡天探测极限的暗星系被观测到（增加数密度），同时也会拉伸局部天区立体角（降低表面数密度）。这两种相反效应的净表现取决于星系光度函数的局域斜率，即放大响应系数（Magnification Response）。在传统的深度测光巡天中，正负响应星系混杂导致的信号相互抵消，使得基于位置交叉相关的放大效应测量信噪比远低于基于形状剪切的测量。
contribution:
本文提出了一种通过优化星系样本选择以充分发掘透镜放大效应宇宙学信息的新框架 **BigMag**：
1. **揭示信号抵消机制并构建响应选择样本**：利用暗能量巡天第六年（DES Y6）测光数据与 Balrog 合成源注入模拟，证实了高红移（$z\simeq0.7$-$2.5$）深度测光样本中正、负放大响应星系的相消是制约信噪比的关键；通过依据放大响应的符号与幅值对背景星系进行分选，**成功消除了信号抵消效应并大幅提升了信噪比**。
2. **实现仅依赖星系位置的高精度宇宙学约束**：在 DES 级别的模拟预测中，结合前景成团性与分选后背景交叉相关的 **BigMag 仅利用星系位置信息即可获得与传统 $2\times2\text{pt}$ 相当的宇宙学参数约束力**。
3. **赋能反向透镜与 $S_8$ 强约束**：分选样本显著增强了反向星系-星系透镜（IGGL，位置样本位于形状样本后方的位置-剪切关联），BigMag 与 IGGL 联合能够实现放大响应的自校准，得到**与传统 $3\times2\text{pt}$ 相当甚至更为严格的 $S_8$ 参数约束**。
4. **拓展低系统误差应用**：该方法还可筛选出近零响应星系样本，有效消除传统 $3\times2\text{pt}$ 及几何透镜比分析中透镜放大带来的系统误差。
summary: Galaxy clustering and weak gravitational lensing are powerful cosmological probes, traditionally combined through galaxy clustering and galaxy-galaxy lensing in a $2\times2$pt analysis. An alternative is the foreground-background clustering cross-correlation induced by lensing magnification, but measurements have achieved lower signal-to-noise than shear-based lensing. We show that, for deep photometric samples, cancellation between galaxies with positive and negative magnification responses can suppress this signal. Using DES Year 6 photometry and Balrog synthetic-source injections, we explore high-redshift ($z\simeq0.7$-$2.5$) samples split by the sign and amplitude of their magnification response. This separation reduces cancellation and can increase both signal-to-noise and cosmological constraining power. We call the combination of foreground clustering and foreground-background cross-correlations with response-selected background samples BigMag. Forecasts with DES-like simulated data vectors show that, for an optimistic sample configuration and sufficiently precise response calibration, BigMag can achieve constraining power comparable to traditional $2\times2$pt using galaxy positions alone. The same samples also enhance inverse galaxy-galaxy lensing (IGGL), a position-shear correlation dominated by magnification when the position sample lies behind the shape sample. Combining BigMag and IGGL further self-calibrates the magnification responses and yields marginalized $S_8$ constraints comparable to traditional $3\times2$pt analyses, and tighter for the more precise calibration scenarios considered here. The framework also enables near-zero-response samples for traditional $3\times2$pt and geometric lensing-ratio analyses. These results motivate further optimization and validation of galaxy selections to realize magnification as a complementary cosmological probe. [Abrg.]

title: Tracing the evolution of galaxy environments with manifold learning
background_knowledge: 星系的形成与演化深受其所处宇宙大尺度环境（如宇宙网中的节点、纤维状结构、片状结构与空洞）的影响。在“先天特质与后天环境”（Nature vs. Nurture）的研究框架下，星系局部环境的密度和几何构型对星系的气体吸积、并合历史、形态演变以及恒星形成熄灭（Quenching）等物理过程起着决定性作用。传统天文学中量化星系环境的方法通常依赖于标量统计量，例如第 $N$ 阶近邻距离密度（$N$-th nearest neighbor density）或固定孔径内的星系计数。然而，这些经典指标往往会过度简化复杂的局部三维几何形态，难以全面捕捉多尺度环境特征及其随宇宙学红移的时域演化。近年来，流形学习（Manifold Learning）与非线性降维算法为高维空间几何表征提供了强有力的工具，使研究者能够从星系邻域分布中提取出更为精细、连续的低维环境特征。
contribution: 本文提出了一种名为 **SONDE**（SOrted Neighbor Distance Embedding）的可扩展流形学习方法，通过改进 Isomap 算法，利用星系邻域间的相似度距离构建低维嵌入空间，实现了对星系局部环境几何结构的精细、连续表征。作者进一步设计了一种将不同数据集投影至同一嵌入空间的泛化方法，从而能够**跨红移系统追踪星系环境的演化**。基于 TNG100 流体动力学模拟在红移 $z = 0 - 5$ 范围内的测试表明，该嵌入空间的表征参数与星系物理性质高度相关。神经网络预测实验显示，**SONDE 的首个嵌入维度在预测星系物理性质方面优于传统的邻近星系计数指标，仅需前三个嵌入维度即可编码相当于 10 阶径向分布剖面的全部环境信息**，且能高度契合星系暗物质晕质量、主星系/卫星星系划分以及恒星形成熄灭等经典环境相关性。
summary: We present SONDE (SOrted Neighbor Distance Embedding): a scalable manifold learning approach to create a nuanced, continuous, low-dimensional representation of the geometry of galaxies' local environments. SONDE is a variation on Isomap that uses similarity distances between galaxy neighborhoods to create an embedding space, within which galaxies cluster according to their neighborhood geometries. We additionally present a novel method to project different datasets into the same embedding space, enabling comparisons of environmental embeddings across redshifts. We demonstrate this method on the TNG100 simulations at $z = 0 - 5$ and show that the embedding values evolve with redshift and correlate with galaxies' physical properties. We train a neural network to predict physical properties based on environmental features and show that our first embedding dimension outperforms a standard environmental quantifier, the number of neighbors, while the top three dimensions encode as much environmental information as a ten-bin radial profile. Our results are consistent with known density correlations, including galaxy halo mass, central vs. satellite status, and quenching. SONDE provides a straightforward way to encode subtleties of galaxy environments that could have significant implications for future analysis of galaxy-environment interactions.

title: The LOFAR Decametre Sky Survey (LoDeSS) I. Survey description and first data release
background_knowledge: 十米波段（频率约 $10$-$30$ MHz）是射电天文学中极具潜力却长期未被充分探索的观测窗口。在该波段，天文学家能够探测到来自老化电子群的超陡谱同步辐射（例如星系团巨型射电晕和化石射电瓣），以及来自行星、恒星磁层甚至系外行星极光的相干射电发射（如电子回旋脉泽不稳定性机制）。然而，地面十米波观测面临着极端严峻的物理挑战：地球电离层的起伏会导致严重的相位和幅度畸变，同时人类活动的强射频干扰（RFI）在低频段尤为剧烈。近年来，以低频阵列（LOFAR）为代表的新一代数字射电干涉阵列，结合先进的电离层自校准算法与夜间观测策略，首次使得在数十兆赫兹频段实现亚角分级的高空间分辨率和高灵敏度大视场巡天成为可能。
contribution: 本研究呈现了 **LOFAR 十米波巡天（LoDeSS）的第一批数据发布（DR1）**，该巡天覆盖了 $15$-$30$ MHz 频段（中心频率 $23$ MHz），目标为赤纬 $> 20^\circ$ 的北半球天空。DR1 覆盖了完整巡天区域的约 **$15\%$**（优先选择包含系外行星极光射电候选体的天区），在 $23$ MHz 处达到了约 **$45^{\prime\prime}$ 的角分辨率** 和约 **$11.5$ mJy beam$^{-1}$ 的典型噪声水平**。观测利用 LOFAR 低频天线阵列（LBA）在夜间通过多波束模式进行，每个指向积分时间约 $5$ 小时。本次向科学界公开的数据产品包括经初级波束校正的 **Stokes I 与 Stokes V 图像** 以及源表，成功展示了 LOFAR 在十米波波段实现前所未有高分辨率和高灵敏度宽视场成像的能力，为系外行星、脉冲星和星系团等极低频射电前沿研究奠定了基石。
summary: The decametre radio sky ($\sim 10$-$30$ MHz) remains largely unexplored due to strong ionospheric distortions and severe radio-frequency interference. Despite its scientific potential, including access to steep-spectrum synchrotron emission from aged electron populations and coherent radio emission from planetary and stellar magnetospheres, sub-arcminute imaging at these frequencies has only recently become feasible with instruments such as the Low Frequency Array (LOFAR). In this work, we present the first data release (DR1) of the LOFAR decametre Sky Survey (LoDeSS), which maps the northern sky above a declination of $20^\circ$ between 15 and 30 MHz. LoDeSS reaches an angular resolution of $\sim45^{\prime\prime}$ and typical noise levels of $\sim11.5$ mJy beam$^{-1}$ at a central frequency of 23 MHz. Observations were obtained with the LOFAR Low Band Antenna (LBA) system using a multi-beam strategy, with typical integration times of $\sim5$ h per pointing. They were carried out at night to reduce the impact of ionospherically reflected radio-frequency interference. Data quality varies across fields as a result of the ionospheric conditions and the fraction of data flagged due to radio-frequency interference. This first release covers $\sim15\%$ of the full survey area and consists of fields originally selected around exoplanet candidates for radio auroral emission. The products released to the community include primary-beam-corrected images in Stokes I and V, and a source catalogue for fields with reliable flux density scales. This release demonstrates that LOFAR enables sensitive, wide-field imaging in the decametre regime with unprecedented resolution, opening new opportunities for studies of pulsars, exoplanetary systems, galaxy clusters, and other low-frequency phenomena.

title: Xenia: A Table-Driven Code for Astrophysical Multi-Fluid Hydrodynamics
background_knowledge: 在天体物理中，多流体流体动力学（Multi-fluid Hydrodynamics）广泛应用于系外行星大气逃逸、原行星盘动力学以及星际介质中尘埃与气体的相互作用等关键领域。以受恒星辐射驱动的行星大气逃逸为例，系统中同时存在中性原子、多种离子及自由电子，不同粒子组分不仅拥有各自的速度场和热压力分布，还通过光致电离、复合反应、辐射加热/冷却以及粒子间碰撞产生极其复杂的非线性耦合。由于微观化学与辐射跃迁的时间尺度通常远小于宏观流体动力学输运尺度，方程组中存在严重的刚性（Stiffness）源项。传统的计算流体代码多将特定的组分定义和相互作用方程硬编码（Hard-code）在求解器内核中，这使得引入新化学网络、修改辐射反应通道或在异构硬件架构间移植变得异常困难且易出错。
contribution:
本研究开发并开源了 **Xenia**（v0.1 版本），一款专为天体物理多流体动力学设计的表格驱动型（Table-driven）模拟代码。论文的核心工作与成果包括：
1. **声明式与符号编译架构**：允许用户在 Python 端声明粒子组分、耦合通道、化学网络与辐射加/冷却机制，代码将其编译为符号指令带（Symbolic tapes），并通过版本化接口传递至底层 C/Kokkos 计算内核，使得**调整物理模型仅需修改高层输入数据而无需改动底层求解代码**。
2. **优化的物理闭合与刚性求解算法**：针对电离介质采用**仅输运压力的准电中性闭合**（不演化电子质量与动量），并基于算子分裂法将多尺度问题解耦为径向辐射扫描、双曲型输运以及基于**解析且无有限差分误差的雅可比矩阵**（Analytic finite-difference-free Jacobian）的高密 LU 局部隐式源项求解。
3. **系统性验证与开源发布**：代码通过了包括声波收敛性、尘埃盒阻力弛豫、两流体激波-云相互作用及行星大气逃逸链等在内的 394 项回归测试，并在 GPLv2 协议下完全开源。
summary: Models of escaping planetary atmospheres require neutral and ion species with distinct velocities and thermal pressures, coupled by photoionization, recombination, radiation, and collisions. Implementing and extending such coupled models is often hindered when species definitions and stiff interactions are embedded in solver-specific kernels. We present Xenia, a table-driven code for astrophysical multi-fluid hydrodynamics designed to lower this barrier. Species, coupling channels, chemistry, heating and cooling, and radiation channels are declared in Python, compiled to symbolic tapes, and passed through a versioned interface to shared C/Kokkos kernels; changing a problem therefore changes data rather than kernel code. For ionized configurations, electrons provide a pressure-only quasi-neutral closure: electron density follows from ion populations, electron mass and momentum are not advanced, and only electron pressure is transported. Stiff coupling is treated by operator splitting into a radial radiation scan, hyperbolic transport, and a cell-local implicit source solve. The same symbolic tapes yield an analytic finite-difference-free Jacobian for a direct dense LU solve. The public v0.1 release is validated with acoustic convergence, dustybox drag relaxation, conservation and closure contracts, two-fluid cloud-shock coupling, curvilinear geometry bookkeeping, three escape chains, and 394 passing tests. Conservation and positivity are not claimed to match mature production codes; radiation uses a radial Beer-Lambert prefix product rather than a general solver; escape chains are reproducibility checks rather than new science predictions; and backend evidence is limited to functional deployment and equivalence fingerprints. Xenia is released under GPLv2 at https://github.com/YFG-tec/xenia.

title: Vector field dark matter search with Sagnac interferometer
background_knowledge: 超轻矢量玻色子（例如与重子数减轻子数 $B-L$ 耦合的暗光子）是一类重要的波状暗物质候选体。当此类暗物质背景场存在时，它会与普通物质发生微弱相互作用，对不同材料成分的测试质量施加依赖于物质组分的微小外力，诱发宏观检验质量之间的相对加速度和微小位移。传统的引力波探测型激光干涉仪（如法布里-珀罗迈克尔逊干涉仪）通常被用作高精度位置测量仪来搜寻此类位移信号。然而，位置测量方案在低频波段深受光子辐射压涨落产生的量子反作用噪声（quantum backaction noise）制约。相比之下，萨格奈克（Sagnac）速度计干涉仪通过测量测试质量的速度响应，能够在物理机制上有效消除低频辐射压量子反作用噪声，因而在低频与低质量暗物质搜寻中展现出巨大的理论潜力。
contribution: 本研究首次计算证明，**采用材料不对称设计的萨格奈克（Sagnac）速度计干涉仪在低频段对 $B-L$ 矢量暗物质的量子噪声受限灵敏度相比法布里-珀罗迈克尔逊位置测量仪提升了近两个数量级**。研究团队在双环形干涉仪构型中引入了不同材料的反射镜以探测依赖于成分的 $B-L$ 作用力，并在相同的入射光功率、输入镜透射率和腔往返光程条件下进行了严格对比。在配置蓝宝石反射镜和为期一周的基准观测设定下，仅考虑量子噪声时，其在质量 $m_A = 4.1\times10^{-14}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^2$（对应频率 $10\,\mathrm{Hz}$）处的 $95\%$ 置信度预期上限达到 **$1.2\times10^{-27}$**，**实现了约 $57$ 倍的灵敏度提升**。分析表明，两种构型下暗物质引起的位移信号响应本质相同，该提升完全归功于**低频量子反作用噪声的显著压制**，表明速度计探测方案是拓展低质量矢量暗物质搜索边界的极具前景的技术路径。
summary: We present the first calculation showing that a material-asymmetric Sagnac speed meter can improve quantum-noise-limited sensitivity to $B-L$ vector dark matter by nearly two orders of magnitude over a Fabry--Perot Michelson position meter at the low-mass end of the band. We introduce material contrast into a dual-ring interferometer to probe composition-dependent $B-L$ forces and compare the two configurations at equal incident power, input-mirror transmissivity, and cavity round-trip length. For sapphire mirrors and a one-week benchmark, the quantum-noise-only median expected $95\%$ CL upper limit reaches $1.2\times10^{-27}$ at $m_A=4.1\times10^{-14}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^2$ ($10\,\mathrm{Hz}$), a factor-$57$ improvement. This band-edge forecast assumes negligible classical noise; sensitivity at $10\,\mathrm{Hz}$ is not established for a realizable suspension and isolation system. The material-induced displacement is essentially identical in both configurations, with the gain arising from reduced low-frequency quantum backaction. These results identify speed-meter readout as a promising route to lower-mass vector-dark-matter searches.

title: Cross-Modal Solar Image Synthesis: Adapting the Surya Foundation Model from He I 10830 Å to EUV Translation and Coronal Hole Segmentation
background_knowledge: 太阳极紫外（EUV）波段成像（如 SDO/AIA 与 SOHO/EIT 卫星观测）是探测太阳日冕精细结构、日冕洞（Coronal Holes, CH）分布及空间天气驱动源的核心手段，但其空间连续观测记录仅始于近几十年。相比之下，地面全日面氦谱线 $\text{He I } 10830\text{ \AA}$ 拥有跨越数十年的长周期历史观测数据。借助跨模态深度学习与太阳基础大模型（Foundation Models），将地基氦线数据转化为高质量的多波段日冕 EUV 图像并提取日冕洞形态，是实现历史太阳活动重构与长期空间天气演化分析的重要技术路径。
contribution: 本研究对 **Surya 太阳基础模型** 进行了微调适配，利用卷积输入适配器、骨干网络低秩更新（LoRA）和专用输出解码器，实现了从全日面 $\text{He I } 10830\text{ \AA}$ 观测向 SDO/AIA 94、193 和 $304\text{ \AA}$ 极紫外图像的跨模态转换以及日冕洞概率图分割（结合 SPOCA 目录监督）。在保留测试集上，模型在三个 AIA 波段分别取得了 **0.8196**、**0.8885** 和 **0.8398** 的日面限制相关系数（CC），日冕洞分割交并比（IoU）达到 **0.4360**。此外，引入的残差细化模块有效增强了空间细节，使前 SDO 时代的合成 AIA $304\text{ \AA}$ 图像与 SOHO/EIT $304\text{ \AA}$ 观测的相关系数从 **0.6511 显著提升至 0.7085**，**充分验证了基于历史氦线观测重构长周期 EUV 日冕形态与跨仪器泛化的可行性**。
summary: The long observational record of He I 10830 Å offers a means to investigate solar morphology before modern extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) imaging. We adapt the Surya solar foundation model to predict Solar Dynamics Observatory/Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (SDO/AIA) 94, 193, and 304 Å images and a coronal hole (CH) probability map from full-disk helium observations. A convolutional input adapter, low-rank backbone updates, and dedicated output decoders learn from temporally paired, geometrically registered observations, with Spatial Possibilistic Clustering Algorithm (SPOCA) catalog polygons providing CH supervision. On observations held out from downstream fine-tuning, the selected dedicated models achieve disk-restricted correlation coefficients (CCs) of 0.8196, 0.8885, and 0.8398 for the three AIA channels, respectively; the CH model achieves an intersection over union (IoU) of 0.4360. The predictions recover broad solar structure, although local agreement varies substantially by channel. An optional residual refiner addresses spatial detail, and its application on pre-SDO dates improves the correlation of synthetic AIA 304 with Solar and Heliospheric Observatory/Extreme-ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (SOHO/EIT) 304 references from 0.6511 to 0.7085. Together, these results support the feasibility of helium-conditioned EUV morphological proxies and motivate their use in historical reconstruction, within the scope of the downstream test and cross-instrument evaluation.

title: Constraints on Nonlinearity of the Mass-Concentration Relation
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学冷暗物质（$\Lambda$CDM）模型框架下，星系团是宇宙中质量最大且已维里化的引力束缚系统。星系团暗物质晕的内部密度分布通常由 NFW（Navarro-Frenk-White）剖面表征，其关键物理性质由总质量 $M$ 和表征核心密集的集中度参数 $c$ 决定。质量-集中度（$M$-$c$）关系直接反映了暗物质晕的结构演化与吸积历史。早期宇宙学模拟通常表明集中度随质量增加而下降（即低质量晕形成更早因而中心更密），但在大质量端，最新理论与高精度数值模拟预言该关系存在非线性特征（例如曲率变化甚至在高红移/超大质量下的回升）。通过弱引力透镜（Weak Gravitational Lensing）对大样本星系团进行精确剪切测量，不依赖流体静力学平衡假设，是观测约束暗物质晕 $M$-$c$ 关系非线性形态及检验暗物质模型的核心途径。
contribution: 本研究发展了一套基于哈密顿蒙特卡洛（Hamiltonian Monte Carlo）的贝叶斯推断框架，系统纳入了集中度内禀弥散、弱透镜非线性校准、测量误差协方差以及底层母体质量分布，利用涵盖 eRASS1、XXL、LoCuSS 及 MCXC 巡天编目的 213 个 X 射线选择星系团样本（$0 < z < 0.9$），首次全面约束了观测中的质量-集中度（$M$-$c$）关系非线性特征。主要结论如下：1. **与模拟高度一致**：无论采用何种理论模型，推断得到的 $M$-$c$ 关系均与**最新数值模拟结果高度吻合**，且在大于 $4\sigma$ 置信度上各模型之间**未出现统计显著差异**；2. **大质量端变平趋势**：数据呈现出集中度质量依赖性在大质量端逐渐变平的物理倾向；3. **非线性模型偏好**：具有正曲率（$\text{d}^2\ln c/\text{d}(\ln M)^2 > 0$）的单调递减模型相比传统单幂律模型与负曲率模型**在 $2\sigma$ 水平上更受观测支持**，相比双幂律模型在 **$0.5\text{--}1\sigma$ 级别上略占优**，为暗物质晕非线性结构的理论模拟提供了清晰的观测证据。
summary: We develop a Bayesian generalization of the previous method to constrain a wide variety of mass-concentration (M-C) relations motivated by both theoretical and observational studies. The framework incorporates the intrinsic scatter in concentration, nonlinear weak-lensing (WL) calibration relations, the WL measurement-error covariance, and the underlying parent mass distribution. We employ Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for computational efficiency. Our sample consists of 213 X-ray-selected clusters with WL measurements for the eRASS1, XXL, LoCuSS, and MCXC catalogs at 0<z< 0.9. For each subsample, we account for its specific WL calibration relation and underlying population distribution. We consider a conventional single power-law model, an empirical double power-law model, and four theoretical models calibrated against numerical simulations. The four theoretical M-C models comprise two in which concentration decreases with mass, distinguished by the sign of d^2ln c/d(ln M)^2, and two in which the concentration decreases with increasing mass before turning upward at high masses. Because the mass and redshift ranges of our cluster sample do not extend into the upturn regime predicted by numerical simulations, we distinguish among the models primarily through the curvature of their M-C relations. Regardless of which model is adopted, the inferred M-C relation is in good agreement with the results of recent numerical simulations. We find no statistically significant differences among the models above the $4σ$ level. However, the result shows a tendency toward a gradual flattening of the mass dependence toward higher masses. Specifically, a monotonically decreasing model with positive curvature is preferred over the single power-law relation and a monotonically decreasing model with negative curvature at the $2σ$ level and over three double power-law models at the $0.5-1σ$ level.

title: A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation
background_knowledge: 地表温度（Land Surface Temperature, LST）是地球物理学、气候变化研究与城市环境监测中的核心参数之一。通过卫星热红外遥感技术（如 Landsat 7、8、9 系列卫星），科研人员能够在大范围空间尺度上反演地表热红外辐射并估算 LST。传统的 LST 反演流程包含辐射定标（Radiometric Calibration）、基于归一化植被指数（NDVI）的比辐射率（Emissivity）估算以及热波段亮度温度转换等多个连续复杂的栅格计算步骤。在传统地理信息系统（GIS）中，人工逐步操作不仅耗时繁琐、易引入人为失误，而且在应对多时相海量遥感数据时效率低下。因此，构建高度自动化的空间数据处理流，并结合大语言模型（LLM）进行统计结果的自动化解释与分析报告生成，是遥感大数据处理与智能地理信息领域的重要演进方向。
contribution:
本文基于 ArcPy 构建了一款适用于 ArcGIS Pro 的自动化遥感分析工具，实现了从 Landsat 7、8、9 数据集中**全流程自动化反演地表温度（LST）**。核心成果与结论包括：

1. **端到端自动化工作流**：该工具免去了人工波段选择与繁琐的栅格代数计算，自动化完成了辐射定标、基于 NDVI 的比辐射率校正及热辐射转换的全过程，并支持单景与批量处理模式。
2. **融合 LLM 智能生成报告**：内置可选的大语言模型接口，能够根据反演统计结果进行**自动化文本解释与综合报告生成**。
3. **大幅提升数据处理效率**：与人工处理所需的 11 至 58 分钟相比，该工具将处理耗时显著缩短至 **4 至 11 分钟**。
4. **实际遥感监测验证**：利用阿联酋哈伊马角（Ras Al Khaimah）的卫星数据进行了实测验证，反演出的 LST 介于 $25\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ 到 $50\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ 之间，与当地实际气象条件高度吻合，验证了其在降低人为误差以及提升热红外环境遥感分析精度与效率方面的实用价值。
summary: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depending on batch size, the tool reduced the processing time from around 11-58 minutes when done manually to around 4-11 minutes using the tool. We tested the tool with data from Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) in the UAE, and the LST obtained for Ras Al Khaimah ranged from approximately 25C to 50C, demonstrating an accurate LST mapping compatible with the weather conditions of RAK. In summary, our tool reduces human errors and improves processing accuracy and efficiency for thermal and environmental remote sensing applications, in addition to providing an interactive LLM-based interface for result interpretation.

title: Unveiling the Origins of the Molecular Gas Reservoirs in Recently Quenched Massive Galaxies
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化的标准范式中，星系主要分为持续进行恒星形成的恒星形成星系（蓝云）和恒星形成活动已停止的熄灭星系（红序列，常被称为“红且死亡”星系）。传统观点认为，星系熄灭的根本原因在于其冷分子气体储量被耗尽、排出或被加热而无法坍缩。分子氢（$\text{H}_2$）是恒星形成的直接原料，由于其对称结构在低温下缺乏有效偶极辐射，观测上通常依赖一氧化碳（$\text{CO}$）分子的跃迁辐射并借助 CO-to-$\text{H}_2$ 转换因子（$\alpha_{\rm CO}$）来推算分子气体总质量。近年来，观测发现在高红移及邻近宇宙中存在部分已经熄灭但仍持有大量分子气体储量的反常大质量星系，这挑战了传统的星系熄灭机制，促使天文学家从暂态演化、观测系统偏差（如 $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ 的非普适性）以及尘埃遮蔽等多重角度重新审视星系熄灭与分子气体的演化联系。
contribution:
本文利用 **Simba 宇宙学流体动力学模拟**，系统调查了红移 $z = 0 - 2$ 范围内恒星质量 $M_* > 3 \times 10^9 M_\odot$ 的富分子气体熄灭星系，评估了三种潜在的物理起源：
1. **尘埃遮蔽机制**：许多看似熄灭的富气体星系实际上仍在进行强烈的恒星形成，但受到尘埃严重遮蔽，其视向光学深度随着红移从 $z = 0$ 到 $z = 2$ 平均由 $\tau_V \sim 0.5$ 显著升至 $2.3$。
2. **转换因子高估机制**：若在非恒星形成星系中直接采用银河系标准的 CO-to-$\text{H}_2$ 转换因子，其分子气体质量会被**高估约 $5$ 倍**（相比之下在正常恒星形成星系中仅高估约 $1.45$ 倍）。
3. **短暂熄灭与复苏机制**：处于演化过渡阶段的星系可能经历时标为 $100\text{ Myr} - 2\text{ Gyr}$ 的短暂熄灭并在后续复苏，该现象在高红移更为显著，但整体占比较低。\n研究表明**以上三种机制在宇宙学尺度上均具备物理合理性**，为解认不同红移下富气体熄灭星系的本质提供了关键依据。
summary: Observations of quenched galaxies across cosmic time have revealed systems containing substantial molecular gas reservoirs, challenging the traditional picture of gas-poor, red and dead galaxies. Using the Simba cosmological simulation, we investigate three possible hypotheses for the origin of molecular gas-rich quenched systems: (i) quiescence is temporary and the galaxy will rejuvenate, (ii) molecular gas masses are overestimated due to an underestimated CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor, or (iii) star formation is ongoing but heavily obscured by dust. Across $M_*>3\times10^9M_\odot$ galaxies from $z=0-2$, we find that all three mechanisms are plausible. Many seemingly quiescent, molecular gas-rich galaxies host dust-obscured star formation, with visual optical depths increasing on average from $τ_V\sim0.5-2.3$ from $z=0-2$. Assuming a Milky Way-like CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor can overestimate molecular gas masses by a factor of $\sim\!5$ in non-star-forming galaxies, compared to $\sim\!1.45$ in star-forming galaxies. Temporary quiescence can also occur in gas-rich transitioning galaxies on timescales ranging from $100\,\text{Myr}-2\,\text{Gyr}$, although this is most prominent at high redshift and is relatively rare overall. Further work is needed to disentangle the relative contributions of these mechanisms across cosmic time.

title: Spatio-temporal progression of star formation in the Carina OB1 association
background_knowledge: OB 星协是由数十到数千颗大质量恒星（光谱型为 O 型和 B 型）组成的松散恒星集合体，通常诞生于巨分子云中，是研究大质量恒星演化、星团动力学以及恒星形成反馈机制的天然实验室。大质量恒星通过强烈的恒星风、电离辐射以及晚期的超新星爆发向周围星际介质（ISM）注入巨大的能量与动量，驱动膨胀的星周气泡并压缩周围气体，从而可能触发下一代星团的序列形成（Sequential Star Formation）。精确刻画星协的时空演化与恒星形成历史，需要结合高精度的星团年龄测定与天体测量数据。借助盖亚空间望远镜（Gaia）提供的超高精度恒星自行与视差数据，天文学家得以重构星团的三维空间分布，并开展动力学反向回溯（Traceback Analysis），进而定量揭示超新星反馈在分子云尺度上对恒星形成的推动作用及其与星系旋臂动力学环境的相互联系。
contribution:
本研究基于 Gaia DR3 高精度天体测量数据，深入剖析了银河系中最著名且质量最大的 Carina OB1 星协中 8 个最具代表性的大质量星团的时空形成历史与动力学演化。主要研究成果包括：

1. **精确测定了星团属性与爆发历史**：确定了各个星团的年龄、恒星族成分、初始大质量恒星含量，并估算了各星团自形成以来的超新星爆发次数。
2. **动力学回溯与触发形成图像**：三维空间位置的 13 Myr 回溯分析表明，最年老星团 NGC 3293（约 13 Myr）诞生于船底座旋臂；约 4 Myr 后该星团内相继发生了约 11 次超新星爆发。由超新星驱动的膨胀气泡与原始分子云复合体南部相互作用，**触发了中央船底座星云（Carina Nebula）内较年轻星团的序列形成**。
3. **量化超新星反馈与大尺度动力学特征**：分析表明在过去 10 Myr 内星协中发生的 **$16 \pm 4$ 次超新星爆发序列对诱导大质量星团形成起到了关键作用**；然而，**超新星反馈并未主导星协的大尺度膨胀**，该区域整体的弥散膨胀更可能反映了最初引力未束缚分子云复合体的初始动力学特征。
summary: The Carina OB1 association, harboring the famous Carina Nebula near its center, is the most massive, well-studied OB association in our Galaxy. Containing several massive star clusters with different ages, it shows a complex spatio-temporal structure. We explore the formation history and kinematic evolution of the eight most massive clusters in Car OB1. We determine the cluster ages, stellar populations, the initial massive star content, and the number of supernova explosions since the time of each cluster's formation. Using Gaia DR3 astrometry, we determine the 3D configuration of the association and perform a traceback analysis of the cluster positions over the last 13 Myr. The traceback analysis places the birth location of the oldest (13 Myr) cluster, NGC 3293, in the Carina spiral arm. Approximately four Myr later, a series of 11 supernova explosions started in NGC 3293. We construct a possible scenario in which the expanding bubble driven by these supernova explosions interacted with the southern part of the original cloud complex and led to the sequential formation of the younger clusters in the central Carina Nebula. Our scenario suggests that the sequence of 16+/-4 supernova explosions in the association during the last 10 Myr played an important role in creating the massive clusters in Car OB1. However, the supernova feedback does not dominate the large-scale expansion of the association; the general expansion rather seems to reflect the initial kinematics of the original unbound cloud complex.

title: Grid Optimization for Wide Field Modulation Collimators
background_knowledge: 在硬 X 射线与 $\gamma$ 射线天文学中，由于高能光子穿透力极强且难以通过常规反射镜面进行高效率聚焦成像，天文学家常采用调制准直器（Modulation Collimator）、旋转调制准直器（RMC）或编码孔径等调制技术来实现高能天体及暂现源（如伽马射线暴 GRB）的空间定位。双光栅调制准直器通过一对透光狭缝阵列对入射天源辐射进行空间角位移调制，从而解码源的到达方向。然而，为了对高能光子保持充分的不透明度，光栅条带（slat）必须具有相当的物理厚度。这会导致严重的几何“自渐晕”（self-vignetting）效应，即厚条带会剪裁离轴入射光束，导致有效透光狭缝宽度随入射角增大而迅速衰减，最终严格限制了准直器的有效视场（FOV），制约了大天区高能瞬变天体的高灵敏度快速定位。
contribution:
本文探索了光栅条带截面几何构型优化对拓展宽视场调制准直器性能的可行性，主要科学与工程发现包括：

1. **建立了通用的双光栅传输函数理论框架**：基于光栅条带截面几何导出了依赖于入射角与形状的有效狭缝宽度模型，系统对比了传统矩形、理想菱形、近似光化学蚀刻特征的六边形以及圆形四种剖面。
2. **证实了菱形与六边形截面可显著拓展有效视场**：在相同栅距与物理厚度下，**菱形剖面可大幅拓宽视场并在绝大部分视场内彻底消除离轴束流剪裁**；同时，工业标准光化学钨蚀刻制备的**六边形截面能够继承理想菱形的大部分优势**。
3. **消除了四相位解调相空间的几何盲区**：将分析拓展至四相位解调方案，揭示条带剖面形状直接决定相空间盲区的分布范围，证明**菱形剖面能够在矩形基准设计受限的目标视场内完全消除解调盲区**。
4. **明确了有限材料不透明度与几何效应的独立性**：证明光子穿透光栅条带引起的能量泄漏不会改变几何盲区边界，确立了**条带截面形状是提升宽视场调制准直器通量与无盲区视场的关键自由度参数**。
summary: Wide-field localization of transient sources such as gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) places new demands on the grid design of modulation collimators, whose usable field of view (FOV) is normally limited by self-vignetting. A grid slat thick enough to be opaque at the energies of interest also clips off-axis rays, shrinking the effective slit width and ultimately defining the FOV itself. Historical bigrid or rotating-modulation-collimator (RMC) designs have been designed with this trade-off as an unavoidable consequence of geometric optics. We explore whether the cross-sectional shape of the grid slats can be optimized for wide FOV applications. We derive a general transmission-function framework for a bigrid pair in terms of an effective slit width that depends on slat geometry and use it to compare four slat cross sections: the conventional rectangular slat, an idealized diamond profile, a hexagonal profile that approximates photochemical etching, and the circular wire grids of early X-ray astronomy. We show that for the same bigrid pitch and thickness, a diamond profile extends the FOV and eliminates clipping throughout most of the field. We also demonstrate that a hexagonal profile achievable with standard tungsten etching factors captures many of the benefits of the idealized diamond profile. Extending the analysis to the four-phase demodulation, we show that slat shape directly sets the extent of the resulting phase-space blind spots, and that the diamond profile removes them entirely across a target FOV where the rectangular baseline cannot. We further show that finite grid opacity is a largely separable effect. Leakage through the grid leaves the geometric blind-spot boundaries unchanged. These results identify slat cross-sectional shape as a design parameter that can substantially increase throughput and widen the blind-spot-free field of view of a wide-field modulation collimator.

title: WEEVIL: design and commissioning of an ice-sublimation chamber and a cryogenic submillimeter radiometer for studying rarefied gas plumes
background_knowledge: 在行星科学与太阳系小天体研究中，彗星以及木卫二、土卫二等冰质卫星（Icy Moons）的表面富含水冰及其他挥发性成分。在太阳辐射或天体内部热源的作用下，这些冰层会发生升华并释放出稀薄的气体羽流（Gas Plumes）或形成彗发。探测并分析这些气体成分通常依赖于亚毫米波外差辐射计，该技术具备极高的光谱分辨率，能够精确测量水分子等挥发分的转动跃迁谱线与动力学特征。然而，准确解译深空探测任务（如 Rosetta、JUICE 等）和地基望远镜的观测数据，需要建立在严格的实验室模拟基础之上，即在受控的高真空与极低温环境下重现冰升华及稀薄气体的膨胀过程。
contribution: 本文介绍了名为 **WEEVIL**（WatEr Emission of Vapor from Ice in the Laboratory）的全新实验装置的设计与调试工作。该装置将**亚毫米波外差辐射计**与**高真空低温实验舱**相结合，能够对受控实验条件下冰升华产生的稀薄气体羽流进行**具备高空间和时间分辨能力的连续监测**。文中详细阐述了实验系统的结构设计与工程实现，并报告了设备试运行的关键成果，展示了在冰升华实验中成功采集到的**首批水蒸气特征光谱**，为后续支持彗星与冰质卫星的科学观测提供了强有力的地面实验平台。
summary: We present WEEVIL (WatEr Emission of Vapor from Ice in the Laboratory), an experimental facility developed to study ice sublimation under laboratory conditions to support observations of comets and icy moons. The setup combines a submillimeter heterodyne radiometer and a high-vacuum cryogenic chamber, enabling spatially and temporally resolved monitoring of gas plumes formed during ice sublimation under controlled laboratory conditions. This paper describes the facility's design and implementation. Furthermore, we present the commissioning of the experimental setup, including the first water-vapor spectra acquired during an ice sublimation experiment.

title: ALMA Observations of Molecular Complexity in the Large Magellanic Cloud: The N83 Star-Forming Region
background_knowledge: 在大质量恒星形成的早期演化阶段，致密的原恒星核会被内部新诞生原恒星加热，形成温度高于 $100\text{ K}$、密度极高且化学组成丰富的致密区域，被称为“热核”（Hot Cores）。在这些区域中，原本冻结在尘埃表面的挥发性分子发生热解吸并释放至气相，引发活跃的气相与尘埃表面化学反应，生成诸如甲醇、乙腈、二甲醚等复杂有机分子（Complex Organic Molecules, COMs）。大麦哲伦云（LMC）作为银河系的近邻矮星系，具有约半太阳金属丰度（$\sim 0.5\ Z_\odot$）和较强的紫外（UV）辐射场，为研究早期宇宙或低金属丰度极端环境下的星际介质化学演化与恒星形成过程提供了天然的近场实验室。利用高分辨率毫米波/亚毫米波干涉仪（如 ALMA）解析其致密核的分子指纹，有助于揭示金属丰度、辐射场及动力学激波对前生命分子形成与存活的关键影响机制。
contribution:
本文利用 ALMA 望远镜在 $1.2	ext{ mm}$ 连续谱和分子谱线波段对大麦哲伦云（LMC）中的 N83 恒星形成区进行了约 $0.1	ext{ pc}$ 空间尺度的观测，并通过 XCLASS 光谱拟合确定了 5 个致密源的物理与化学特性：
1. **确认热核证认与复杂有机分子探测**：在 N83A-mm A 和 B 中测得温度超过 $100	ext{ K}$、尺度紧凑且 $	ext{H}_2$ 体积密度极高，**成功证实其为热核（Hot Cores）**；并在其中探测到了甲醇（$	ext{CH}_3	ext{OH}$）、乙腈（$	ext{CH}_3	ext{CN}$）和二甲醚（$	ext{CH}_3	ext{OCH}_3$）等复杂有机分子，同时在冷核及更大尺度上检测到了延展的冷甲醇辐射。
2. **丰富的同位素与含硫分子化学**：在致密核中探测到了 SO、$	ext{SO}_2$、OCS、CS、SiO、HNCO、HDCO 等多种含硫及激波示踪分子。相对 $	ext{H}_2$ 的分子丰度分析表明，**$	ext{CH}_3	ext{OH}$ 丰度存在显著弥散，而含硫分子的丰度变化相对较小**，与麦哲伦云热核的普遍趋势一致。
3. **揭示反馈激波与微环境的主导作用**：观测发现了强紫外辐射和复杂动力学特征，表明**恒星形成反馈产生的激波（Shocks）是驱动含硫分子、SiO 以及 $	ext{CH}_3	ext{OH}$ 化学反应的关键动力**，证明局域微环境对低金属丰度恒星形成核的化学丰度与组分具有决定性影响。
summary: We report the results of the 1.2 mm continuum and molecular line $\sim$0.1 parsec-scale observations with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array of two fields in the star-forming region N83 in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC). This study is third in a series of investigations exploring molecular complexity in a low-metallicity and high UV flux environment of the LMC. We determine the physical and chemical properties of five sources detected with ALMA based on spectral modeling with XCLASS and the analysis of the continuum emission. The temperatures exceeding 100 K, small sizes, and high H$_2$ volume densities of sources N83A-mm A and B indicate that they are hot cores. N83A-mm A/B are associated with complex organic molecules: methanol (CH$_3$OH), methyl cyanide (CH$_3$CN), and dimethyl ether (CH$_3$OCH$_3$). We also found CH$_3$OH in three cold cores, and extended cold CH$_3$OH emission in both fields. We detected SO, $^{33}$SO, SO$_2$, OCS, H$_2$CS, CS, C$^{33}$S, HC$^{15}$N, H$^{13}$CN, HNCO, HDCO, H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$, SiO, and CH$_2$CO in at least one core. Molecular abundances with respect to H$_2$ fit into the trends previously reported for the Magellanic hot cores: the CH$_3$OH abundance varies significantly, while the abundances of S-bearing species show small variations. We found evidence for strong UV radiation and complex kinematics in both ALMA fields in N83. The feedback-produced shocks are important drivers of the chemistry of S-bearing species, SiO, and CH$_3$OH in and outside hot cores. Local effects have a large impact on the chemical composition and abundances of star-forming cores in the LMC.

title: Limited Impact of CMB B-mode Polarization on Constraints on Cosmic Topology
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准模型通常默认宇宙具有全局平庸的拓扑结构（如无限延伸的平坦欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^3$）。然而，广义相对论仅规定了时空的局部曲率几何，宇宙整体的全局拓扑形态仍属未知。在多连通（multiply connected）的紧致宇宙模型中（例如立方三维环面 $E_1$ 拓扑），有限且周期性的边界条件会打破大尺度的统计各向同性，导致宇宙微波背景（CMB）辐射涨落的球谐系数 $a_{\ell m}$ 之间产生非对角（off-diagonal）关联。CMB 的各向异性信号主要包括温度涨落（T）以及极化模式（无旋的 E 模与有旋的 B 模），其中原初 B 模极化源自暴胀时期的张量扰动（原初引力波）。评估各极化分量在谐空间对拓扑诱导关联的敏感度，是探索宇宙全局空间结构的关键途径。
contribution: 本文系统研究了 CMB 原初 B 模极化对立方三维环面（$E_1$）宇宙拓扑的约束能力。研究团队构建了包含温度（T）、E 模和原初 B 模各向异性在不同 $(\ell, m)$ 模式间完整非对角关联的谐空间协方差矩阵；为剥离观测噪声与引力透镜干扰，在**理想宇宙方差极限**（cosmic-variance-limited）条件下，基于标准各向同性 $\Lambda\text{CDM}$ 模型生成随机模拟并评估了高斯似然。研究发现，即使在理想条件下，**引入原初 B 模极化也仅能极微弱地提升（marginal improvement）区分 $E_1$ 拓扑与平庸拓扑的能力**。这种不同观测量间的约束力差异，主要源于各分量传输函数的物理响应特征与谐空间拓扑关联结构的协同作用。
summary: The global spatial structure of the universe is a fundamental question in cosmology. Although the standard model usually assumes a trivial topology, a multiply connected universe can break statistical isotropy and generate off-diagonal covariance between the spherical-harmonic coefficients of cosmic microwave background fluctuations. In this work, we investigate whether CMB B-mode polarization improves constraints on the cubic three-torus, or $E_1$ topology. We construct the full harmonic-space covariance matrices of the temperature, E-mode, and primordial B-mode anisotropies, including correlations between different $(\ell,m)$ modes, and evaluate Gaussian likelihoods using random realizations generated from a statistically isotropic $Λ$CDM model with trivial topology. To isolate the intrinsic topological information carried by each CMB observable, we consider the ideal cosmic-variance-limited case, neglecting instrumental noise and gravitational lensing. We find that adding primordial B-mode polarization yields only a marginal improvement in the ability to distinguish the $E_1$ topology from the trivial topology, even under these ideal conditions. The different constraining powers of the temperature, E-mode, and B-mode anisotropies can be understood through the combined effects of their transfer-function responses and the topology-induced off-diagonal correlations in harmonic space. }

title: Fast and Stable Nonlinear Emulation of TIEGCM Using an Autoregressive SINDy Framework
background_knowledge: 随着低地球轨道（LEO）中人造卫星与空间碎片数量的剧增，空间态势感知（Space Situational Awareness, SSA）和碰撞规避预警变得愈发紧迫。在近地空间环境中，热层大气阻力是影响航天器轨道衰减与碰撞概率预测的最主要不确定性来源。目前用于模拟热层密度演化的第一性原理物理模型（如热层-电离层-电动力学广义环流模型 TIEGCM）虽然具备较高的物理真实度，但其计算复杂度极高、耗时长，难以满足实时轨道预报、不确定性量化以及在轨自主计算的工程需求。因此，利用降阶建模与数据驱动的非线性动力学系统辨识方法（如 SINDy 算法）构建快速、稳定且高保真的大气密度代理模型，已成为空间科学与航天动力学交叉领域的前沿研究方向。
contribution:
本研究基于非线性动力学稀疏辨识方法，开发了一种稳定自回归模型框架 **SINDy-AR**，并将其深度集成到降阶概率仿真器（ROPE）的动态建模模块中，用于仿真 TIEGCM 模拟的高维热层大气密度。主要贡献与结论包括：

1. **首次高维系统应用**：首次将 SINDy-AR 框架成功推广并应用于高维复杂热层动力学仿真，通过严格的稳定性和精度筛选准则，确保了代理模型在实际空间态势感知任务中的可靠性。
2. **动力学特征重构**：所学得的状态依赖代理模型能够准确捕捉热层密度在多时间尺度上的物理特征，**完全兼容日三潮（terdiurnal）、与太阳自转相关的 27 天周期、半载及周年潮汐波等动力学模态**。
3. **极致计算加速**：SINDy-AR 完整计算管线相比于 TIEGCM 2.0 实现了约 **90,000 倍的速度提升**，由于其极低的计算开销，该模型**具备直接部署在卫星星载计算平台上进行自主轨道与环境预测的能力**。
summary: The ever-growing number of satellites and resident space objects in low Earth orbit keeps increasing the risk of collision between these objects. To mitigate this risk, the development of new space situational awareness tools and a new generation of probabilistic emulators of the thermosphere is increasingly felt by the community of operators and scientists. We previously built a Reduced Order Probabilistic Emulator based on 3 steps: dimensionality reduction, dynamic modeling, and uncertainty quantification. Here we further develop the dynamic modeling side within ROPE using a class of stable and autoregressive nonlinear models inspired by SINDy, a framework for the identification of the nonlinear dynamics. We use this framework, which we call SINDy-AR, to emulate the thermospheric density simulated by TIEGCM. This is also the first time a SINDy-AR framework is applied to such a high dimensional system as the thermospheric emulation because of its complexity. The dynamical emulators are selected on stability and accuracy criteria, so that they can be relied on in operations and space situational awareness applications. Building surrogate models with SINDy-AR can show dynamical differences between the learned emulations. The state-dependent structure of the TIEGCM emulation shows compatibility with the presence of terdiurnal, 27-day linked to solar rotation, semiannual, and annual tidal waves. The execution speedup of the whole SINDy-AR pipeline with respect to TIEGCM 2.0 is about 90,000 times, which makes the new framework capable of being deployed on board a satellite given the low computational constraints it would be subjected to.

title: LoFreq-SETI: A Low-Frequency Technosignature Search Pipeline for the LWA Swarm
background_knowledge: 地外智慧生命搜寻（Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence, SETI）旨在通过探测电磁波段中的异常信号寻找宇宙中的先进文明痕迹，这类非自然产生的观测指征被称为“技术签名”（Technosignatures）。在射电波段，以往的 SETI 探索大多集中在 $1\sim 10\text{ GHz}$ 的微波频段；尽管低于 $100\text{ MHz}$ 的甚低频射电波段在人类地表通信中被极广泛使用，但由于电离层干扰及仪器限制，天文学界在这一频段的 SETI 搜索仍严重不足。近年来，随着长波阵列（Long Wavelength Array, LWA）等低频干涉仪的发展，利用波束合成与孔径合成干涉技术探索这一前沿波段成为可能。
